13. atha netrakarmavidhiradhyāyaḥ

Larger type: Śārṅgadharasaṃhitā · Dī.: Āḍhamalla's Dīpikā · Gū.: Kāśīrāma's Gūḍhārthadīpikā
trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ | atha netraprasādanakarmāṇi vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | sambandhaścāyaṃ - śirāvyadhenā'pi netraprasādanaṃ bhavati, tadvatsekādibhirapi | ata āha - tāni kāni karmāṇītyāha - seka āścotanaṃ piṇḍī biḍālastarpaṇaṃ tathā | puṭapāko'ñjanaṃ caibhiḥ kalpairnetramupācaret || 1 ||
Dī. athedānīṃ netraprasādanakarmāṇi vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | seko'tra dhārādinā svedarūpaḥ | āścyotanaṃ netramadhye tailādikṣepaṇarūpam| nimīlitonmīlanākṣibhedena sekaāścyotanayorbhedamāhuḥ | piṇḍīti prasiddhā | akṣṇorbahirlepaḥ sa biḍālasaṃjñaḥ | tarpaṇamiti netratṛptikaraṃ karma tacca netrabastiriti prasiddham | puṭapāka iti | puṭapāka uktyā dravyasya raso netraprasādane vihitaḥ sa puṭapākaḥ kathitaḥ | asyāpi dvividhaṃ karma vyācakṣate | ekaṃ tarpaṇavat kāryam aparaṃ āścyotanavaditi | añjanaṃ prasiddhaṃ tacca nānāvidham cakārāt śastrakarmāpyatra boddhavyamiti kecit | na svamatam | tadanyatra jñātavyam || 1||
Gū. atha netraprasādanakarmāṇi | ebhiḥ sekādibhiḥ kalpairnetrarogam upācaret | eṣāṃ lakṣaṇāni vakṣyati || 1 ||
sekavidhiḥ | sekastu sūkṣmadhārābhiḥ sarvasminnayane hitaḥ | mīlitākṣasya martyasya pradeyaścaturaṅgulāt ||2 || sa cāpi snehano vāte rakte pitte ca ropaṇaḥ | lekhanaśca kaphe kāryastasya mātrā'dhunocyate || 3 || ṣaḍvākśataiḥ snehaneṣu caturbhiścaiva ropaṇe | vākśataiśca tribhiḥ kāryaḥ seko lekhanakarmaṇi ||4|| kāryastu divase seko rātrau cātyayike gade |
Dī. pūrvamuktaṃ seka āścyotanapiṇḍītyādikam | tatra tāvatsekavidhiradhunā vidhīyate sūkṣmadhārā netrāñjanaśalākā'nurūpaṃ nirgatā dravapātrāt | sarvasminnayane iti sarvākṣiroge yathā doṣāpekṣayā vā sarvagrahaṇaṃ | samastanetramaṇḍale ityeke | caturaṅgulamiti caturaṅgulaṃ yathā syāt tena caturaṅgulotsedhaṃ dhārāṃ kṛtvā secayedityabhiprāyaḥ | yadvā yathā sukhotsedhaṃ secayedityapi | athavā caturaṅgulenākṣivistāraṃ yāvat tāvanmaryādīkṛtya dravyakalkaṃ kṛtvā karpaṭe badhvākṣisekaḥ kartavya iti saṃpradāyaḥ | tathāhyuktam - ‘avyakte'kṣigade kāryaṃ plotasthairguṇḍanaṃ bahiḥ’ ityādi | atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa sekasya karmaviśeṣamāha - vāte kevalānilajanite'kṣirogaḥ, snehanaḥ snehakṛtasvedaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ | yathā - ‘sarpirmāsavasāmajjābhedaḥ syādauṣadhaiḥ kṛtaḥ | snehana iti vikhyātaḥ’| raktapitta iti vyaste milite vā ropaṇaḥ svedaḥ | ropaṇastu tantrāntare yathā - ‘stanyajāṅgalamadhvājyatiktakadravayācitaḥ | dṛṣṭerbalārthaṃ śītaśca svedaḥ kāryo'pi ropaṇam’ iti | kaphe kaphaprāye'kṣiroge lekhanaḥ sveda iti lekhano doṣalekhana iti, sa ca snigdhasya vihitaḥ | tathāhi - ‘sneho hitotirūkṣasya snigdhasyāpi hi lekhanaḥ| jāṅgalānāṃ yakṛnmāṃsairlekhanadravasaṃyutaiḥ || kṛṣṇaloharajastāmraśaḍkhavidrumasindhujaiḥ | samudraphenakāsīsasrotojadadhimastubhiḥ | lekhane lekhanasvedo vihitoyaṃ bhiṣagvaraiḥ’ iti | tasyeti trividhasekasya mātrāparimāṇaṃ kāryaṃ kālaṃ vā adhunā idānīṃ tasya mātrā'dhunocyate ityuktaṃ prāk tadidānīṃ tanmātrāviśeṣamāha - srehaḥ teṣu svedeṣu ṣaṭśatavākyāni yāvat bhavanti tāvat snehasvedaḥ kartavya ityabhiprāyaḥ | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā | tathāhi ‘nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ puṃsāmaṅgulyā cchoṭikāthavā | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā vāṅmātreyaṃ smṛtā budhaiḥ’ iti | atraikaladhvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vāgiti paṭhanti | ropaṇe svedaścaturbhiriti catuḥśatavākyaiḥ lekhanakarmaṇīti lekhanasvede | ekaśatavākyaiḥ kṛtvā tāvat svedaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ | athākṣisvedasya kālamāha - ātyantake gade prakupite'kṣiroge rujādibhiḥ pīḍita ityarthaḥ | rātrau vetyatra vāgrahaṇāt niśāyāḥ, prathamo yāmo'bhipretaḥ | tathāhi - ‘snigdhoṣṇairvātajaḥ pittaraktato mṛduśītalaiḥ | tīkṣṇarūkṣoṣṇaviśadaiḥ praśāmyati kaphātmakaḥ | tīkṣṇoṣṇamṛduśītānāṃ vyatyāsāt sānnipātikaḥ | tasya kālo divā sarvo yāmaḥ syāt prathamo niśi’ iti || 2-4 ||
Gū. atha sekaḥ | mīlitākṣṇa: mudritanetrasya puruṣasya sekaḥ pradeyaḥ | seka: secanaṃ, sa sekaḥ sarvasminnayane caturaṅgulāt sūkṣmadhārābhihitaḥ | dhārāśabdo dugdhādivācakaḥ | sekasya snehādibhedena trividhatvamāha - sa eva sekaḥ secanaṃ vāte ca ropaṇaḥ kaphe lekhanaḥ tasya sekasya mātrāpramāṇam adhunā ucyate tāṃ mātrāmāha - sneheṣu ṣaḍvākśataiḥ sekaḥ kāryaḥ | caturbhirvākśataiḥ ropaṇe sekaḥ kāryaḥ | lekhanakarmaṇi tribhirvākśataiḥ sekaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ | sekaḥ kadā kārya ityāha -sekastu divasa eva kāryaḥ | anyadapi asādhuko rātrāvapi || 2-4 ||
atha trividhākṣisvedānāṃ prayogadvāreṇa karma darśayannāha - sa yathā - sa yathetyādinā darśayati granthakāraḥ | eraṇḍatvakpatramūlaiḥ śṛtamājaṃ payo hitam ||5|| sukhoṣṇaṃ secanaṃ netre vātābhiṣyandanāśanam | pariṣeko hito netre payaḥ koṣṇaṃ sasaindhavam || 6 || rajanīdārusiddhaṃ vā saindhavena samanvitam | vātābhiṣyandaśamanaṃ hitaṃ mārutaparyaye || 7 || śuṣkākṣipāke ca hitamidaṃ secanakaṃ sadā | sābaraṃ madhukaṃ tulyaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ sucūrṇitam ||8|| chāgakṣīre ghṛtaṃ sekātpittaraktābhighātajit | triphalālodhrayaṣṭībhiḥ śarkarābhadramustakaiḥ ||9|| piṣṭaiḥ śītāmbunā seko raktābhiṣyandanāśanaḥ | lākṣāmadhukamañjiṣṭhālodhrakālanusārivāḥ || 10 || puṇḍarīkayutaḥ seko raktābhiṣyandanāśanaḥ | śvetalodhraṃ ghṛte bhṛṣṭaṃ cūrṇitaṃ paṭavisrutam || 11 || uṣṇāmbunā vimṛditaṃ sekācchūlaghnamambake |
Dī. eṣa ca vātābhiṣyande praśastaḥ | abhiṣyando netrāmayaḥ sarasapākarujaḥ | ayamapi sarvākṣirogotpādaka ityarthaḥ | tathāhi ‘vātāt pittāt kaphādraktādabhiṣyandaścaturvidhaḥ | prāyeṇa jāyate ghoraḥ sarvanetrāmayākara’ iti | eraṇḍapatretyādiyoge kṣīrasādhanaṃ kṣīraparibhāṣayaiva boddhavyam | tantrāntare'yamadhimanthanāmnā vihitaḥ tatra kaṇṭakārīyutamiti paṭhanti | tathāca -‘kaṇṭakārīśiphairaṇḍamūlatvakpatrasādhitam | kṣīramājaṃ hitaṃ seke cakṣu:spandādhimanthayoḥ’ iti | anyacca ‘pariṣeke hitaṃ netre payaḥ koṣṇaṃ sasaindhavam | rajanīdārusiddhaṃ vā saindhavena samanvitam | vātābhiṣyandaśamanaṃ hitaṃ mārutaparyaye | śuṣkākṣipāke vihitamidaṃ secanakaṃ sadā | pariṣekaṃ sekābhidhānaṃ payotrājaṃ gavyaṃ vā mānuṣamiti kecit | koṣṇamīṣaduṣṇam | saindhavamiti sasaindhavacūrṇaprakṣiptam | athavā rajanīdārusiddhaṃ paya iti yogaḥ | kṣīrapākamatra kṣīraparibhāṣayā kartavyam | rajanī dāruharidrā | eke rajanīdārudravyadvayaṃ vadanti | tatra rajanī haridrā dāru devadāru | mārutaparyāyepi hitametat | mārutaparyāyaṃ tat sarvāṅgam akṣiroge paṭhanti | tadyathā ‘vāraṃ vāraṃ ca paryeti bhruvau netre ca mārutaḥ | rujaśca vividhāstīvrāḥ sa jñeyo vātaparyaya’ iti | śuṣkākṣipāke ca idameva secanaṃ sadā sarvasminkāle kṛtau vā hitamityarthaḥ | śuṣkākṣipākamapi sa cākṣigata eva boddhavyaḥ | tadyathā ‘yat kūṇitaṃ dāruṇarūkṣavartma saṃlakṣanetrāviladarśanaṃ yat | sarūkṣaṇaṃ yat pratibodhane ca śuṣkākṣipākopahataṃ tadakṣi’iti | idānīṃ raktapittābhiṣyandanāśanārthaṃ yogamāha -pittābhighātobhiṣyanda eva | yaṣṭīmadhu yaṣṭī bhadramustakaḥ śreṣṭhamustaḥ nāgaramothā iti loke piṣṭa iti kalkīkṛtaḥ | ayaṃ poṭṭalakaḥ baddhena chedo vihitaḥ | poṭṭalakadvāreṇaiva tadadharāseka ityanye | tagaraṃ, sārivā āsphotā, puṇḍarīkaṃ kamalaṃ tadabhāve tadbījānyatra gṛhyante | atra kvātharūpeṇa seko boddhavyaḥ | athākṣisādanaharayogamāha | ayaṃ dhārābhidhānopi svedaḥ poṭṭalakena badhvā kartavya iti saṃpradāyaḥ | ambake netre || 5-11 ||
Gū. sa yathā - sukhoṣṇam ājaṃ payaḥ netre secane hitaṃ | kiṃbhūtaṃ payaḥ | eraṇḍatvakpatramūlai: śṛtaṃ kvathitaṃ | punaḥ kiṃbhūtaṃ | vātābhiṣyandam āgataḥ pākaṃ netraṃ | vātābhiṣyande sekaḥ, anyacca pariṣeke secane sasaindhavaṃ koṣṇaṃ payaśchāgīdugdhaṃ netre hitaṃ, rajanī haridrā dāru devadāru saindhavena samanvitaṃ tatsiddhaṃ ca hitaṃ | kiṃbhūtaṃ | vātābhiṣyandaśamanaṃ tathā mārutaparyāyeṇa roge | tathā śuṣkākṣipāke hitaṃ vātābhiṣyande vātaparyaye śuṣkākṣipāke sāvaraṃ lodhraṃ madhukaṃ yaṣṭī etat tulyaṃ saṃcūrṇitaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ punaḥ chāgīkṣīre sthitaṃ sekāt secanāt pittaraktābhighātajidbhavati | abhighāto netrābhighātaḥ | netrābhighāte sekaḥ śarkarā sitā'bhiṣyande kālānisārivā kalisāri | puṇḍarīkaṃ śvetakamalaṃ, raktābhiṣyande paṭavisṛtaṃ vastrapūtaṃ, punaḥ uṣṇāmbunā marditam, ambake netre sekātsecanāt śūlaghnaṃ bhavati netraśūleti ||5-11||
āścyotanam | athāścyotanakaṃ kāryaṃ niśāyāṃ na kathaṃcana ||12|| unmīlite'kṣṇi dṛṅmadhye bindubhirdvyaṅgulāddhitam | bindavo'ṣṭau lekhaneṣu snehane daśa bindavaḥ || 13 || ropaṇe dvādaśa proktāste śīte koṣṇarūpiṇaḥ | uṣṇe ca śītarūpāḥ syuḥ sarvatraivaiṣa niścayaḥ ||14|| vāte tiktaṃ tathā snigdhaṃ pitte madhuraśītalam | tiktoṣṇarūkṣaṃ ca kaphe kramādāścyotanaṃ hitam ||15|| āścyotanānāṃ sarveṣāṃ mātrā syādvākśataṃ hitā | nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ puṃsāmaṅgulyośchoṭikā'thavā || 16|| gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā vāṅmātreyaṃ smṛtā budhaiḥ |
Dī. athāścyotanamāha - āścyotanaṃ netrasecanaṃ, taccādāveva sarveṣāmakṣirogāṇām | uktaṃca vāgbhaṭe - ‘sarveṣāmakṣirogāṇāmādāvāścyotanaṃ hitam | rūkṣoṣṇakaṇḍūgharṣāśrudāharoganibarhaṇam’ iti | atrādāviti nirāmāvasthāyāṃ vātapittavajjñeyam | nirāmāvasthā ca rūkṣādyupalakṣitā jñeyā | uktaṃca videhe - ‘abhiṣyande'vamanthe ca netrayoḥ kaphasaṃbhave | utpanna eva kartavyaṃ netrayoḥ kaphanāśanam | lākṣyāścākṣṇoḥ parīṣekastīkṣṇaścāścotanādikam iti | atra sāmanirāmalakṣaṇaṃ ca yathā - ‘udīrṇavadanaṃ netraṃ rāgadveṣasamanvitam | gharṣanistodaśūlāsrayuktamāmānvitaṃ viduḥ | mandavedanatākaṇḍūḥ saṃrambhastu prasannatā | praśastavartmatā cākṣṇoḥ saṃpakvaṃ gadamādiśet’ iti | niśāyāṃ na kathaṃ cana iti | rātrau na kartavyamevetyanena divā kartavyatā'sya pratipāditā | dvyaṅgulāditi | dvyaṅgulotsedhaṃ kṛtvā dvyaṅguloccenopādeyamityarthaḥ | bindubhiriti | binduparimāṇaṃ ca vāgbhaṭe - ‘pradeśinyaṅgulaparvadvayānmagnasamuddhṛtāt| yāvatpatatyasau bindurdṛśāṣṭau ṣaṭ krameṇa te’ iti | lekhanādiṣu bindusaṃkhyāmāha - bindava iti | bindavo lekhane'ṣṭau, snehane daśa, ropaṇe dvādaśa | te śīte koṣṇarūpiṇa iti | te bindavaḥ śīte śītakāle hemante śiśire ca koṣṇarūpiṇaḥ koṣṇāḥ | evam uṣṇakāle śītarūpiṇaḥ | eṣa niścayaḥ sarvatra lekhanādau jñeya: | vātādikramāt snigdhādikamāha - vāta iti | vāto'tra netrābhiṣyandādau tiktarasaprāyaṃ snigdhaṃ ca hitam | pitte madhuraśītalaprāyaṃ, kaphe tiktoṣṇarūkṣaṃ ca āścyotanaṃ netrasecanarūpam iti | athā'ścyotanaṃ mātrāsvarūpamāha - āścyotaneṣviti | sarveṣu lekhanādiṣu vākśatamiti | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vāk netrasecane tu snehanādiṣu mātrāviśeṣaḥ proktaḥ | atra tu netramadhye bindukṣepaṇatvena sarveṣu vākśatamātrameva | kecidatra mātrālakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti tadyathā -‘nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ puṃsāmaṅgulyā choṭikāthavā | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā vāṅmātreyaṃ smṛtā budhaiḥ’ iti | ayaṃ pāṭho bahupustakeṣu nāsti || 12-16 ||
Gū. athāścyotanam | athānantaram āścyotanaṃ kathyate tat āścyotanaṃ niśāyāṃ rātrau na kāryaṃ kathaṃcana | tallakṣaṇamāha – unmīlita uddhāṭite'kṣṇi dṛṅmadhye dvyaṅgulāt bindubhiryaddīyate tadevāścyotanam | lekhanādau kiyanto bindavo deyāstadāha - te bindavaḥ śīte śītakāle koṣṇarūpiṇaḥ uṣṇe uṣṇakāle śītarūpa eṣa niścayaḥ | vātādau kīdṛśā āścyotanā deyāstadāha -sugamam | āścyotananāmānyāha - budhaiḥ paṇḍitaiḥ iyaṃ vāṅmātrā smṛtā | keyaṃ tadāha sarveṣāṃ āścyotanānāṃ vāṅmātrā hitā nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ nimeṣo netranimeṣastanyaunmeṣakaraṇaṃ tathā aṅgulyācchoṭikī gurvakṣaro dīrghākṣarastasyoccāraṇaṃ dvayaṃ vāṅmātrā ekā || 12-16 ||
athāścyotanārthaṃ yogānāha - bilvādipañcamūlena bṛhatyeraṇḍaśigrubhiḥ || 17 || kvātha āścyotane koṣṇo vātābhiṣyandanāśanaḥ | ambupiṣṭairnimbapatraistvacaṃ lodhrasya lepayet || 18 || pratāpya vahninā ṣiṣṭvā tadraso netrapūraṇāt | vātotthaṃ raktapittotthamabhiṣyandaṃ vināśayet || 19|| triphalāścyotanaṃ netre sarvābhiṣyandanāśanam | strīstanyāścyotanaṃ netre raktapittānilārtijit ||20|| kṣīrasarpirghṛtaṃ vāpi vātaraktarujaṃ jayet |
Dī. araṇi: agnimanthabhedaḥ tadabhāve agnimantha eva dviguṇaḥ kārya iti paribhāṣoktatvāt | athānyaprakāramāha - lodhro vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ tasya tvak tvaca eva lodhrasaṃjñā vikhyātā | atra strīdugdhaṃ saṃmiśryāścyotanaṃ kāryamiti vyavahāraḥ | tantrāntare'pi ‘nimbasya patraiḥ parilipya lodhnaṃ svedāgninā cūrṇamathāpi kalkam | āścyotanaṃ mānuṣadugdhayuktaṃ pittāsradāhāpahamagryamukta’miti | aparamapi ‘triphalāścyotanaṃ netre sarvābhiṣyandanāśanam’ | triphalāścyotanamiti kvātharūpam | athavāhimakaṣāyarūpaṃ boddhavyaṃ kalkarūpamityeke | yaduktaṃ ‘jātā rogā vinaśyanti na bhavanti kadācana | triphalāyāḥ kaṣāyeṇa prātarnayanadhāvanaḥ || strīstanyāścyotanaṃ netre raktapittānilārtijit | kṣīrasarpirghṛtaṃ cāpi vātaraktarujaṃ jayet’ | kṣīrasarpiriti dohanamātreṇaivotpannaṃ taṃ haiyaṅgavīnamityāhuḥ | kṣīramatra gavyam | tathāca ‘gavyakṣīrotthitaṃ sarpistarpaṇārthaṃ vidhīyate | dṛṣṭiprasādanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ timirasyāpi karṣaṇa’miti | yadvā kṣīreṇa sādhitaṃ sarpiḥ kṣīrasarpiḥ ghṛtamiti kevalaṃ gavyamājaṃ vā grāhyam | strīstanyādiyogoyamapi āgantujadoṣe praśasta ityāhuḥ | tantrāntarīyoktatvāt | yaduktam ‘āgantudoṣaṃ prasamīkṣya kāryaṃ vaktroṣmaṇā svedanamāditastu | āścyotanaṃ strīpayasā ca sadyo yaccāpi pittakṣatajāpahaṃ syāt’ iti || 17-20 ||
Gū. tadyathā - bilvādipañcamūlena ‘bilvāgnimanthasyonākapāṭalā kumbhakārā bṛhatī kaṇṭakārī vātābhiṣyande ambu jalaṃ tatpiṣṭairnimbapatrairlodhrasya tvacaṃ lepayet | tāṃ tvagninā pratāpya piṣṭvā tadrasaḥ netrapūraṇād abhiṣyandaṃ vināśayet | raktavātapittābhiṣyande kṣīrasarpirdugdhaghṛtaiḥ | ghṛtaṃ manthanotthaṃ, āścyotane abhiṣyandaśūle || 17-20 ||
idānīṃ piṇḍikāvidhānamāha - piṇḍī kavalikā proktā badhyate paṭṭavastrakaiḥ ||21|| netrābhiṣyandayogyā sā vraṇeṣvapi nibadhyate | abhiṣyande'dhimanthe ca saṃjāte śleṣmasaṃbhave ||22|| snigdhasvinnottamāṅgasya śirastīkṣṇairvirecayet | adhimantheṣu sarveṣu lalāṭe vyadhayecchirām || 23 || aśānte sarvathā manthe bhruvorupari dāhayet | abhiṣyandeṣu sarveṣu badhnīyātpiṇḍikāṃ budhaḥ ||24||
Dī. vraṇeṣvapi nibadhyata iti | vraṇamatra śastrakṣārāgnikṛtaṃ jalaukāpātanakṛtaṃ vā tatraiva boddhavyam | anyadvraṇaṃ ca yannetrayordoṣajanitam | tathāgantuje piṇḍīvihitā athāsyāgre'bhiṣyandādhimanthayoḥ karmāntaroktaṃ ślokadvayamāhureke | etaddvayaṃ ca prakaraṇāntaroktatvenāsmābhirapi nātra varṇitam | asaṃgatatvāt | atha sarvābhiṣyandipiṇḍikāviṣayamāha - sarveṣviti | vātapittakapharaktasvarūpeṣu | budhairiti grahaṇena yathāyogyaṃ dravyādikaṃ vicārya badhnīyādityarthaḥ | ata eva vātābhiṣyande snigdhoṣṇā piṇḍikā deyā | evaṃ pittaraktādike madhuraśītetyabhiprāyaḥ || 21-24 ||
Gū. atha piṇḍikā vastrapaṭṭakaiḥ badhyate sā piṇḍikā balikā ca proktā sā netrābhiṣyandayogyā | vraṇeṣvapi sā badhyate | athābhiṣyande śirovirecanamāha śleṣmasaṃbhave abhiṣyande tathādhimanthe netraroge snigdhasvinnottamāṅgasya puruṣasya śirastīkṣṇairnasyairvirecayet srāvayet | snigdhakṛtatailābhyaṅgasvinnaṃ sveditam uttamāṅgaṃ mastakaṃ yasya saḥ | tasya adhimanthānyākriyāmāha - sugamam || 21-24 ||
idānīṃ piṇḍikārthaṃ prayogavarānāha - vātābhiṣyandaśāntyarthaṃ snigdhoṣṇā piṇḍikā bhavet | eraṇḍapatramūlatvaṅnirmitā vātanāśinī || 25 || pittābhiṣyandanāśāya dhātrīpiṇḍī sukhāvahā | mahānimbaphalodbhūtā piṇḍī vā pittanāśinī ||26|| śigrupatrakṛtā piṇḍī śleṣmābhiṣyandanāśinī | nimbapatrakṛtā piṇḍī śleṣmapittaharā bhavet || 27 || triphalāpiṇḍikā proktā nāśane śleṣmapittayoḥ | piṣṭvā kāñjikatoyena ghṛtabhṛṣṭā ca piṇḍikā ||28|| lodhrasya harati kṣipramabhiṣyandamasṛgbhavam | śuṇṭhīnimbadalaiḥ piṇḍī sukhoṣṇā svalpasaindhavā ||29|| dhāryā cakṣuṣi saṃyogācchothakaṇḍūvyathāpahā |
Dī. tatra vātābhiṣyandanāśanī yathā (vāteti) | atrairaṇḍasya patrāṇi mūlaṃ tvak cāṅgatrayaṃ saṃgṛhya kalkamāhuḥ | kalkārthaṃ cātra payaḥ ityapare | sāmānyatvena jalaṃ deyamiti sarvatra | vātanāśinītyanenaiva kevalaṃ vātābhiṣyande kathitaṃ kintu adhimanthādīnāṃ vātarujāyāmapi śastametat | evaṃ pittakaphayorapi boddhavyam | atha pittābhiṣyandanāśanārthaṃ piṇḍīyogamāha - dhātrī āmalakīphalaṃ | atra peṣaṇārthaṃ kāñjikaṃ jalaṃ vā sarvatra | mahānimbo nimbārkaḥ sa ca vakāṇaniṃbaśabdavācyaḥ | atrāpyanukte jalam | eke śigrupatrakṛtetyādikaṃ pāṭhamanyathā paṭhanti ‘śigrupatrakṛtā piṇḍo śleṣmābhiṣyandahāriṇī | nimbapatrakṛtā piṇḍī vātapittavināśinī’ iti śleṣmapittayoriti | atha śleṣmābhiṣyande yogamāha | śigruḥ sobhāñjanakaḥ triphalā haritakyādikam| atrāpi kalkārthaṃ yathāyogyaṃ vihitaṃ dravaṃ deyam | atha raktābhiṣyandārthaṃ yogamāha - piṣṭvā kāñjikatoyeneti | kāñjikadravabhāgena| tadabhāve jalamatra grāhyam | tena pūrvaṃ lodhraṃ kāñjikena saṃpiṣya paścāt ghṛtena saṃpācya piṇḍikā kāryā | athābhiṣyandādīnāṃ śothakaṇḍūharaṇārthaṃ yogottamamāha | atra śuṇṭhīnimbadalāpekṣayā svalpo deyaḥ | svalpasaindhaveti śuṇṭhīmānāllaghutaram saṃyogo piṇḍīviśeṣaṇam | tena saṃyogayuktā vastrapaṭṭādibhiḥ susaṃhatā ityarthaḥ | eke saṃyogāditi pañcamyantaṃ paṭhanti | tatrāsyāḥ saṃyogādeva śothādayo yāntīti bhāvaḥ || 25-29 ||
Gū. athābhiṣyande kriyāmāha | atha vātādināśe piṇḍikāmāha - mahānimbaphaleti | vāte pitte ca piṇḍī | atha śleṣmābhiṣyande piṇḍī śigruḥ śobhāñjanaḥ | atha śleṣmapittaraktābhiṣyande piṇḍī ghṛtamṛṣṭā kāñjikapiṣṭā lodhrapiṇḍikā asṛgbhavaṃ raktabhavam abhiṣyandaṃ harati | śothakaṇḍvādau piṇḍī nimbadalaiḥ nimbapatraiḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 25-29 ||
atha biḍālavidhiḥ | biḍālako bahirlepo netre pakṣmavivarjitaḥ || 30 || tasya mātrā parijñeyā mukhalepavidhānavat |
Dī. idānīṃ biḍālakaviṣayamāha - mukhalepavidhānavadityanena yathā mukhalepavidhistadvadatrāpi boddhavyaṃ, mukhalepavidhistu pūrvādhyāye lepanamūrdhatailakarṇapūraṇākhye jñātavyaḥ || 30 ||
Gū. atha biḍālaḥ netrapakṣmavivarjite bahirbhāge yo lepaḥ sa biḍālaka ucyate tasya mātrā mukhalepamātrā mukhalepavidhānavadvijñeyā || 30 || atha lepaḥ |
sa yathā - dī. - atha lepamāha - sa yathetyanena yogān darśayati gnanthakāraḥ | yaṣṭīgairikasindhūtthadārvītārkṣyaiḥ samāṃśakaiḥ ||31|| jalapiṣṭairbahirlepaḥ sarvanetrāmayāpahaḥ | rasāñjanena vā lepaḥ pathyāviśvadalairapi || 32 || kumāri kāgnipantrairvā dāḍimīpallavairapi | vacāharidrānimbairvā tathā nāgaragairikaiḥ || 33 || dagdhvā sasaindhavaṃ lodhraṃ madhūcchiṣṭayute ghṛte | piṣṭamañjanalepābhyāṃ sadyo netrarujāpaham || 34 || lohasya pātre saṃghṛṣṭo raso nimbaphalodbhavaḥ | kiṃcidghano bahirlepānnetrabādhāṃ vyapohati || 35 || saṃcūrṇya maricaṃ keśarājasvarasamardanāt | lepanādarmaṇāṃ nāśaṃ karotyeṣa prayogarāṭ || 36 || svināṃ bhittvā viniṣpīḍya bhinnāmañjananāmikām | śilailānatāsindhūtthai: sakṣaudrai: pratisārayet || 37||
Dī. yaṣṭī madhuyaṣṭī | eke yaṣṭīsthāne pathyāṃ paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | pathyā harītakī sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ dārvī haridrā tārkṣyaṃ rasāñjanaṃ tadabhāve dāruharidrā dviguṇā grāhyā taddravatvāt aparamapi vakṣyamāṇacatuṣṭayaṃ sarvanetrāmaye vihitamiti śeṣaḥ | kiṃ tadāha - rasāñjanena lepa eko yogaḥ | rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthasamudbhavaṃ dravyaviśeṣaḥ | viśvādalairapi pathyā viśvadalairapi dvitīyo yogaḥ | pathyā harītakī viśvaṃ śuṇṭhī etayordalāni patrāṇi athavā dalasthāne jaleti pāṭhaḥ | tatra jalaṃ vālakaṃ | vacā haridrā viśvaiḥ kṛtvā tṛtīyo yogaḥ | nāgaragairikaiścaturthaḥ viśvānāgaraśabdābhyāṃ śuṇṭhī kathitā | badhvā sasaindhavaṃ lodhraṃ madhūcchiṣṭaghṛtapiṣṭamañjanalepābhyāṃ sadyo netrarujāpahaṃ saindhavamatra manāk deyam | madhūcchiṣṭaṃ sikthakam | loke momaśabdavācyam | ghṛtamatra gavyaṃ lepotra punarjalena pracarati añjanaṃ tu ghṛtenaiva vyavahāraḥ | sadyo netrarujāpahamiti | abhiṣyandodhimanthādīnāṃ vedanāpahamiti | ayaḥ ‘lohapātreṇa saṃghṛṣṭo raso nimbūphalodbhavaḥ | kiṃcidghano bahirlepo netrabādhaṃ vyapohati’ | nimbūphalarasastu lohapātre prakṣipya tadanu lohadaṇḍenāpi gharṣayet yāvat ghano bhavati | eke lohapātreṇetyasya sthāne kāṃsyapātreṇeti paṭhanti mānayanti ca | netrabādhāmiti netravyathāṃ tenābhiṣyandādīnāmityarthaḥ | athārmanāśanārthaṃ yogamāha | keśarājo mārkavaḥ loke ghamarāśabdavācyaḥ | armātiraktārmasaṃjñaṃ, netrābhyantaresya pracāra ityeke | prayogarāṭ prayogaśreṣṭhaḥ | svinnāṃ bhitvā viniṣpādya bhinnāmañjananāmikāṃ śilailāmanasindhūtthaiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet | pratisārayedityanena śilācūrṇaṃ kṛtvā kṣaudreṇa saṃplāvya yojyaṃ | kutra yojyaṃ tadāha añjananāmikāmiti | guhāñjanīti loke | sā ca paṭalante pakṣmasamīpe bhavati | svinnāmiti tāṃ pūrvaṃ saṃsvedya paścāt śastreṇa bhitvā vidārya tadanu niṣpīḍyata iti pūyamānīya paścāt pratisārayet| ata eva bhinnāmiti viśeṣaṇamasyāḥ śilailanatasindhūtthairiti śilā manaḥśilā elā kṣudrailā, nataṃ tagaraṃ, sindhūtthaṃ saindhavam || 31-37 ||
Gū. sa yathā - yaṣṭī madhuyaṣṭī, dārvī dāruharidrā, tārkṣyaḥ kharparaṃ, samāṃśakaiḥ samabhāgaiḥ sarvanetrāmayāpahaḥ sarve ye netrāmayā abhiṣyandādayastān hanti | anyacca rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthodbhavaṃ, pathyā harītakī, viśvā śuṇṭhī, dalaṃ patrajaṃ, kumārī, agnipatraiḥ etaiḥ ṣaḍyogāḥ | anyacca lodhraṃ saindhavaṃ agnau dagdhvā madhūcchiṣṭe ghṛte kṛtam etatpiṣṭam añjanalepābhyāṃ sadyo netrarujāpahaṃ bhavati | anyacca sugamam | athārmasu lepaḥ maricaṃ saṃcūrṇayitvā keśarājo bhṛṅgarājaḥ, tasya svarasamardanāt punaḥ lepanāt eṣaḥ prayogarāṭ armaṇāṃ nāśaṃ karoti | arma vraṇaviśeṣaḥ | atha pratisāraṇam añjananāmikāṃ svinnāṃ sveditāṃ punaḥ bhitvā vidārayitvā punaḥ viniṣpīḍya pīḍayitvā śilā elā nataṃ tagaraṃ sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ sakṣaudrairetaiḥ pratisāraṇaṃ kuryāt | netrāñjananāmikā netrapiḍakā || 31-37 ||
tarpaṇam | atha tarpaṇakaṃ vacmi netratṛptikaraṃ param | yadrūkṣaṃ pariśuṣkaṃ ca netraṃ kuṭilamāvilam || 38 || śīrṇapakṣmaśirotpātakṛcchronmīlanasaṃyutam | timirārjunaśukrādyairabhiṣyandādhimanthakaiḥ || 39 || śuṣkākṣipākaśothābhyāṃ yuktaṃ vātaviparyayaiḥ | tannetraṃ tarpaṇe yojyaṃ netrarogaviśāradaiḥ || 40|| durdinātyuṣṇaśīteṣu cintāyāsabhrameṣu ca | aśāntopadrave cākṣṇi tarpaṇaṃ na praśasyate || 41 || vātātaparajohīne deśe cottānaśāyinaḥ | ādhārau māṣacūrṇena klinnena parimaṇḍalau || 42 || samau dṛḍhāvasaṃbādhau kartavyau netrakośayoḥ | pūrayedghṛtamaṇḍena vilīnena sukhodakai: || 43 || athavā śatadhautena sarpiṣā kṣīrajena vā | nimagnānyakṣipakṣmāṇi yāvatsyustāvadeva hi ||44|| pūrayenmīlite netre tata unmīlayecchanaiḥ | dhārayedvartmarogeṣu vāṅmātrāṇāṃ śataṃ budhaḥ || 45 || svacche kaphe sandhiroge mātrāpañcaśataṃ hitam | śukle ca ṣaṭśataṃ kṛṣṇaroge saptaśataṃ matam ||46|| dṛṣṭirogeṣvaṣṭaśatamadhimanthe sahasrakam | sahasraṃ vātarogeṣu dhāryamevaṃ hi tarpaṇam || 47 || svinnena yavapiṣṭena snehavīryeritaṃ tataḥ | yathāsvaṃ dhūmapānena kaphamasya viśodhayet || 48 || ekāhaṃ vā tryahaṃ vāpi pañcāhaṃ ceṣyate param | tarpaṇe tṛptiliṅgāni netreṣvetāni bhāvayet || 49 || sukhasvapnāvabodhaṃ ca vaiśadyaṃ varṇapāṭavam | nivṛttirvyādhiśāntiśca kriyālāghavameva ca ||57|| atha sāśru guru snigdhaṃ netraṃ syādatitarpitam | rūkṣamasnāvilaṃ rugṇaṃ netraṃ syāddhīnatarpitam || 51 || rūkṣasnigdhopacārābhyāmetayoḥ syātpratikriyā |
Dī. idānīṃ tarpaṇavidhānaṃ darśayannāha - athetyādi | biḍālānantaraṃ tarpaṇakaṃ dṛṣṭiprasādanakaṃ karma vacmi | kīdṛśaṃ netraṃ tarpaṇayogyaṃ bhavati tadāha - yadrūpamityādi | yādṛśaṃ rūkṣaṃ pariśuṣkamiti vātābhiṣyandādeva | āvilaṃ kaluṣaṃ śīrṇapakṣmeti romaśātanaṃ śirotpāta iti yathā - ‘avedanā vāpi savedanā vā yasyākṣirājyo hi bhavanti tāmrāḥ | muhurvirajyaṃti ca yāḥ sa tādṛgvyādhiḥ śirotpāta iti pradiṣṭa’ iti | kṛcchronmīlanasaṃyutamiti kṛcchronmīlanaḥ ākuṃcanasaṃjñaḥ | yathā -‘vātādyā vartmasaṃkocaṃ janayanti gatā yadā | tadā draṣṭuṃ na śaknoti kuṃcanaṃ nāma tadviduḥ’iti | timirārjunaśukrādyairiti timiraṃ tu liṅganāśasya mūlameva | yataścaturthapaṭalagato doṣastimiraṃ karoti tacca nānārūpaṃ bhavati | arjunamiti śuklabhāgagatarogaviśeṣaḥ | yaduktaṃ ‘eko yaḥ śaśarudhiropamaśca binduḥ śuklastho bhavati tadarjunaṃ vadantī’ti | śukramiti kṛṣṇabhāgagataṃ tacca trividhaṃ śuddhaśukraṃ śirāśukraṃ kṣataśukraṃ ceti | śukramatra puṣpaśabdavācyaṃ phūlīti loke | ādigrahaṇādetādṛśairanyairapi | abhiṣyandādhimanthakairiti abhiṣyando netrāmayaḥ | ayamapi sarvanetrarogotpādaka ityarthaḥ | adhimantho netre śotharūpo rujāvāṃśca bhavati sa ca vṛddhenābhiṣyandenaiva kriyāvatāṃ tatpuruṣāṇāṃ caturvidho jāyate | śuṣkākṣipākaśothābhyāmiti śuṣkākṣipākaḥ sarvākṣigataroge paṭhitaḥ sa yathā - ‘yatkūṇitaṃ dāruṇarūkṣavartma saṃdahyate cāviladarśanaṃ yat | sudāruṇaṃ yatpratibodhane ca śuṣkākṣipākopahataṃ tadakṣī’ti | śotha iti | śothajanetrapākaḥ | yataḥ -‘kaṇḍūpadehāśruyutaḥ pakkodumbarasannibhaḥ | saṃraṃbhī pacyate yastu netrapākaḥ sa śothaja’ iti | vātaviparyayairyuta iti vātaviparyayo netrarogaviśeṣaḥ | ayamapi sarvākṣigataroge paṭhitaḥ | yathā ‘vāraṃvāraṃ ca paryeti bhruvau netre ca mārutaḥ | rujaśca vividhāstīkṣṇāḥ sa jñeyo vātaparyaya’ iti | taṃ netraṃ tarpaṇe yojyamiti yatpūrvoktarogaviśeṣe varṇitaṃ tannetramityarthaḥ | tarpaṇaṃ tu vakṣyamāṇaṃ boddhavyam | atha tarpaṇakriyāyāmayogyaviṣayamāha - durdinātyuṣṇaśītairityanena śītoṣṇavarṣāsvarūpaṃ kālaṃ tarpaṇavihitam | prāptiniṣedhatvāt | durdinamiti varṣā meghavṛṣṭyākulaṃ dinaṃ niṣiddhaṃ nānyat | evamatyuṣṇamiti | grīṣme kharatarakiraṇatāpitadivasam | atiśītaṃ vātādivyāptaṃ dinamiti saṃbhrameṣviti bhramaścakrārūḍhasyevārthāsaṃvittiḥ | aśāṃtopadrave cākṣṇīti | āmadoṣajananopadravasahitaṃ nākṣi tarpayedityabhiprāyaḥ| tadyathā - ‘udīrṇavedanaṃ netraṃ rāgaśoṣasamanvitam | gharṣanistodaśūlāśruyuktamāmānvitaṃ vidu’riti | idānīṃ tarpaṇasya kartavyavidhāvapi karmavidhānamāha - tarpaṇārthī puruṣaḥ prathamameva śobhanaṃ sthānamanvicchet | tatra vātātaparajorahite iti| etayorlakṣaṇatvenāgnidhūmarahite iti grahaṇaṃ | yaduktaṃ - ‘pratisūryāgnirahite nīrujo dhūmamārute | gṛhe sukhe nirābādhaṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca samācaredi’ti | uttānaśāyinetyanena niścalasya vītakrodhatayāsya cāvarodhaḥ tantrāntaradarśanāt ‘uttānaśāyinaḥ kāryaṃ niścalasya yathāsukham | tarpaṇaṃ netrayugale vītakrodhabhayasya ce’ti | atha paścātkarmāha - ādhārau māṣacūrṇena netrakośayoriti netrapuṭayoḥ | dvau ādhārau kuryāt | ādhāro māṣapiṣṭīmayaḥ palīsaṃjñaḥ | klinnena māṣacūrṇeneti | klinnaṃ jalena marditam | kathaṃbhūtāvādhārāviti | parimaṇḍalau pari samantato bhāvena maṇḍalākārau tenārdhāṅgulotsedhaḥ dvyaṅgulavistāraṃ yathā syāt kuryādityabhiprāyaḥ | tathāhi ‘ardhāṅgulo'rdhavistāraṃ yathā syānnākṣirodhakṛt’ iti | punaḥ kathaṃbhūtāvādhārau | samāhitau na viṣamaiḥ | dṛḍhāviti na śīrṇau | asaṃdhāviti saṃdhirahitau | etena tannipuṇena kāryāvityarthaḥ | idānīṃ tarpaṇārthaṃ dravyaviśeṣamāha - pūrayennetrādhārāviti śeṣaḥ | kena pūrayettamāha - ghṛtamaṇḍenetyādi | vilīnaghṛtasya ghanībhūtasyoparitano bhāgo ghṛtamaṇḍa ityucyate | kīdṛśena sukhodakaiḥ kṛtvā vilīne | eke sukhodarkairevākṣipūraṇamāhuḥ | tadasaṃgatam | athavetyanena dravyāntaramāha - dhautena sarpiṣetyarthaḥ | kṣīramathanātsamudbhūtaṃ navanītaghṛtaṃ kṣīraghṛtamityucyate | kṣīramatra gavyaṃ grāhyaṃ tadvihitatvāt | tathāhi - ‘gavyakṣīrotthitaṃ sarpistarpaṇārthaṃ vidhīyate | dṛṣṭiprasādanaśreṣṭhaṃ timirasyāpakarṣaṇa’miti | atha kiyatparimāṇena pūraṇaṃ kāryaṃ tamāha - eke tu ‘pakṣmāṇi yāvanmajjanti romavattā yadā bhruvo’riti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca tata unmīlayecchanairiti | unmīlanaṃ tu śanaiḥ kuryāt | śanairityanena karmāntaraṃ sūcayati | kathamunmīlayettadāha carakaḥ - ‘tato vastreṇa pītena nīlena haritena vā | patrairācchādya nayane tataḥ paśyedyathāsukhami’ti | atha tarpaṇasya dhāraṇaṃ kiyatkālena kāryaṃ tadāha - vartmarogeṣviti kṛcchronmīlanapakṣmaghātaprabhṛtiṣu | vāṅmātrāṇāṃ śatamiti| gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vāk teṣāṃ śatamityarthaḥ| athavāṅgulyoḥ choṭikāsvarūpaṃ vāṅmātrātmatvena kathitam | tathāca ‘nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ puṃsāmaṃgulyācchoṭikāthavā | gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā vāṅmātreyaṃ smṛtā budhairi’ti| svasthe kaphe iti prakṛtisthe kaphe athavā svasthe puruṣe nīroge, nirupadrave ityanye ata eva sopadrave doṣe tarpaṇaṃ na vihitamiti pūrvoktameva | saṃdhirogajalasrāvaprabhṛtike kṛṣṇaroge śuddhaśukraśirāśukrapramukhe kaphe ca vikārābhipanne ata eva ṣaṭśatamityarthaḥ | pañcaśatān dṛṣṭirogeṣviti pitte nakulāndhyaprabhṛtiṣu dṛṣṭirogeṣviti bahuvacanatvena pittaje raktaje vā'ṣṭauśatāni kuryāt | adhimanthe sahasrakamityasya sthāne adhimanthe navaśatamiti paṭhanti | sahasraṃ vātarogeṣviti bahuvacanatvenāpi sannipātātmake vyādhau sahasramātraṃ yāvaddeyaṃ | tantrāntare saptaśatamātrābhiḥ sannipāte vihitam | tathāca ‘vācāṃ sahasramātrā syāddhārayenmārutavyathe | pittaje raktaje vā... ...niva | sannipātātmake saptapañca svasthavidhau tathe’ti viṣayovagantavyaḥ | atha kaphasnehopanayanaṃ kuryāttamāha - idānīṃ doṣādiviśeṣeṇa tarpaṇaviśeṣasya dināntaramāha - ekāhamiti | ekadināntaraṃ granthakāradarśanāt| tathā ca - ‘ahanyahani vātotthe pittarakte dināntaram | tarpaṇaṃ sannipātotthadvyantaraṃ tryaṃtaraṃ kaphe’ iti | tatra pittaraktādidoṣe tarpaṇaṃ kāryam | vāgrahaṇena vātotthepi ahanyahani kāryaṃ dvitīyavāgrahaṇenāpi dvyantaraṃ boddhavyaṃ sannipātaviṣayaṃ eke kaṭūṣṇamiti paṭhanti | tryahamiti tridināntaraṃ tacca kaphetyanukte svasthādāvapi | pañcāhamiti pañcadināntaram | atha tarpaṇaliṅgāni yasya bhavanti tānāha - sukhaṃ yathā syāt | svapnāvabodho bhavati | vaiśadyaṃ netrasyeti | varṇapāṭavamiti varṇaṃ śvetakṛṣṇādikaṃ tasya pāṭavaṃ nirmalatvam etena vyaktavartmane bhavataḥ | nivṛttiravalokanapracāro dṛḍhataro bhavati | kriyālāghavamiti sūkṣmāvalokanepi samarthadṛṣṭirbhavatītyarthaḥ | athātitarpitasya lakṣaṇānyāha - atheti sugamam | atha hīnatarpitasya lakṣaṇamāha - rūkṣamasnigdham, asrāvilam asrairnetrajalairāvilaṃ kaluṣīkṛtaṃ rāgamāraktatāṃ hīnatarpitanetramiti | atha hīnātitarpitasya netrasya kiṃcitprakāramāha - etayorhīnātitarpitayoḥ | tenātitarpitasya netrasya kiṃcitprakārato rūkṣakriyāhīnatarpitā snigdhā kriyetyabhiprāyaḥ || 38-51 ||
Gū. atha tarpaṇam athānantaraṃ tarpaṇakaṃ cikitsitaṃ vacmi kathayāmi | tarpaṇakaṃ netratṛptikaraṃ | keṣu rogeṣu tarpaṇaṃ kriyate tānāha - yannetraṃ rūkṣaṃ bhavati | śuṣkaṃ kuṭilaṃ vakram āvilaṃ malayuktaṃ śīrṇapakṣma śīrṇaṃ gataṃ | pakṣma netrarogaṃ yasya tat | ete vātaparyantādayo netraroganidāne jñeyāḥ | evaṃbhūtaṃ netraṃ tarpaṇe yojyaṃ | netrarogaviśāradairvaidyaiḥ yatra tarpaṇaṃ na vihitaṃ tadāha - sugamam | yatra tarpaṇaṃ na hitaṃ yena vidhānena vā tadāha - vātādīnāṃ hīne rahite deśe uttānaśāyinaḥ puruṣasya netrakośayoḥ uparibhāge klinnena ārdreṇa māṣacūrṇena parimaṇḍalau maṇḍalākārau samau dṛḍhau asaṃbādhau kartavyau | tatra netre vilīnena drutena ghṛtagaṇḍena pūrayet | sukhodakairvā athavā | śatadhautena sarpiṣā kṣīrotthitena sarpiṣā vā yāvat akṣipakṣmāṇi nimagnāni bhavanti tāvat kāryaṃ | mīlite netre pūrayet | pūraṇānantaraṃ tataḥ śanaiḥ unmīlayet | dhāraṇe pramāṇamāha - vāṅmātrālakṣaṇaṃ gurvakṣaroccāraṇādikaṃ pūrvoktameva | sugamaṃ cānyat | tarpaṇe dāhakaphādhikye pratīkāramāha - tataḥ snehavīryeṇa īritam asya kaphasvinnena yavapiṣṭena yathāsvaṃ dhūmapānena viśodhayet | tarpaṇaṃ kiyaddinaparyantaṃ kartavyaṃ tadāha - ekāhaṃ tryahaṃ paraṃ pramāṇaṃ pañcāhaṃ vā iṣyate | atha tarpaṇe tṛptilakṣaṇamāha - tarpaṇe netrasya sukhasvapnādīni tṛptiliṅgāni bhāvayet vicārayediti pūrveṇānvayaḥ | sukhena svapnatvaṃ sukhena bodhatvaṃ vaiśadyaṃ viśadatā netrasya | varṇasya pāṭavaṃ paṭutvaṃ nirvṛttirnirāvṛttiḥ spaṣṭadarśanatvaṃ vyādhiśāntiḥ | kriyālāghavaṃ nimeṣonmeṣakriyālaghutvam | atitarpitamāha - sāsru-asruyuktaṃ guru snigdhaṃ ca | atha hīnatarpitanetramāha - rūkṣam asrāvilaṃ raktāvilaṃ rugṇaṃ rogayuktaṃ hīnatarpitaṃ netram evaṃ syāt | atitarpitahīnatarpitayoḥ pratikāramāha - rūkṣopacāreṇātisnigdhasya na hīnasnigdheneti yāvat || 38-51 ||
puṭapākaḥ | sambandhaścāyaṃ - tarpaṇoktavidhānakriyāvyāpattisamānadharmatvaṃ puṭapākamāha - ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi puṭapākasya sādhanam ||52|| dvau bilvamātrau māṃsasya piṇḍau snigdhau supeṣitau | dravyāṇāṃ bilvamātraṃ tu dravāṇāṃ kuḍavo mataḥ ||53|| tadekasthaṃ samāloḍya patraiḥ supariveṣṭitam | puṭapākena tatpaktvā gṛhṇīyāttadrasaṃ budhaḥ || 54 || tarpaṇoktavidhānena yathāvadupacārayet | dṛṣṭimadhye niṣecyaḥ syānnityamuttānaśāyinaḥ ||55|| snehano lekhanaścaiva ropaṇaśceti sa tridhā | hitaḥ snigdho'tirūkṣasya snigdhasyāpi hi lekhanaḥ ||56|| dṛṣṭerbalārthamitaraḥ pittāsṛgvraṇavātanut | sarpirmāṃsavasāmajjāmedaḥsvādvauṣadhaiḥ kṛtaḥ || 57 || snehanaḥ puṭapākaśca dhāryo dve vākśate dṛśoḥ | jāṅgalānāṃ yakṛnmāṃsairlekhanadravyasaṃyutaiḥ || 58 || kṛṣṇaloharajastāmraśaṅkhavidrumasindhujaiḥ | samudraphenakāsīsasrotojadadhimastubhiḥ || 59 || lekhano vākśataṃ dhāryastasyaitāvadvidhāraṇam | stanyajāṅgalamadhvājyatiktakadravyapācitaḥ || 60 || lekhanāttriguṇo dhāryaḥ puṭapākastu ropaṇaḥ | vitarettarpaṇoktāṃ tu kriyāṃ vyāpattidarśane || 61 ||
Dī. atha puṭapākavidhānamāha - atha puṭapākasya traividhyamāha - sa puṭapākaḥ | atha teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ madhye kaḥ kasya vihitastamāha - atirūkṣasya puruṣasya snigdhasyāpi puruṣasyeti śeṣaḥ | lekhano lekhanaḥ puṭapākaḥ | dṛṣṭerbalārthaṃ dṛṣṭidṛḍhīkaraṇārtham itaro ropaṇapuṭapākaḥ | sa eva pittāsṛgvraṇavātanut | vraṇavātādayo netragatā eva boddhavyā: | idānīṃ snehanapuṭapākamādau pradarśayannāha - vasāmāṃsāśritaḥ | sneha iti śeṣaḥ | tathāca ‘śuddhamāṃsabhavaḥ snehaḥ sā vasā parikīrtitā’ majjā mastakamajjā sthūlāsthiṣu ca bhavati | bheda udarasthatvagasthiṣu ca | tathācoktaṃ ‘sthūlāsthiṣu viśeṣeṇa majjā tvabhyantarāśritā | athetareṣu sarveṣu saraktaṃ meda ucyata’ iti | dṛśa iti | dṛśi madhye niṣevya iti viṣayaḥ | atha lekhanapuṭapākamāha - jāṅgalānāṃ jantūnāṃ yakṛnmāṃsairiti | yakṛtkālakhaṇḍaḥ | yadyapi jāṅgalavargo'ṣṭavidha: kathitaḥ | tadyathā jāṅgalā viṣkirāḥ pratudā guhāśayāḥ | prasahā: parṇamṛgā bileśayā grāmyāśceti | tathāpi keṣāṃcinmate paṃcaiva śreṣṭhatamā: jāṅgalaviṣkirapratudaparṇamṛgabileśayāśca te ke jāṅgalādyāstān keṣāṃcit jñāpanārthamāha - eṇahariṇaparṇakuraṅgādayo jāṅgalāḥ | lāvatittirakapiñjalavartīrurvādayaḥ | viṣkirāḥ kapotapārāvatakaliṅgādayaḥ | pratudā: siṃhavyāghravṛ(ṣā?)śvakaśṛgālamārjārādayo guheśayāḥ | kākakaṅkakuraracāṣabhāsādayaḥ | prasahā: mṛdubhūrivakavṛkṣaśāyikāvānaraprabhṛtayaḥ | parṇamṛgāḥ śvāvicchaśagodhānakulādayo bileśayāḥ| aśvāśvataragokharoṣṭrabastorabhramedaḥpucchaprabhṛtayo grāmyā iti jāṅgalavargaḥ samāsena proktaḥ | yadyasya doṣasya vihitaṃ tattatraiva jñātavyam | lekhanadravyasaṃyutairiti lekhanadravyairvakṣyamāṇakṛṣṇaloharajaḥprabhṛtikaiḥ īdṛśaiścetyabhiprāyaḥ | kṛṣṇaloharajaḥkṛṣṇasāravarṇatāmrarajaśca vidrumaṃ pravālaṃ siṃdhujaṃ saidhavaṃ kāsīsaṃ dvividham ekaṃ bhasmasadṛśaṃ kiṃcidamlalavaṇarasaṃ, dvitīyaṃ puṣpakāsīsam īṣatpītaṃ tuvaraṃ tadbhavameva srotoñjanamiti | rasāñjanaśabdavācyaṃ tacca dvividham | ekaṃ srotoñjanakṛṣṇapāṣāṇākṛti dravyam | aparaṃ tu dāruharidrākvāthena kṛtrimaṃ pītalohitaṃ | mastu dadhnastoyaviśeṣam | tathāca ‘dadhnastu yadadhastoyaṃ tanmastu parikīrtita’miti | athāto ropaṇapuṭapākamāha - stanyaṃ strīdugdhaṃ tadabhāve gavyamājaṃ vā | jāṅgalaśabdena jāṅgalaprāṇināṃ vasā majjā medo grāhyaṃ ropaṇakriyāyāṃ vihitatvāt | madhu kṣaudram ājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tiktakagavyaṃ niṃbaprabhṛtikaṃ lekhanatriguṇo dhārya ityanena vākśatatrayaṃ sūcitam | atha puṭapākavyāpatticikitsāmāha - vitarediti | puṭapākavyāpattidarśane hīnātiyoge tarpaṇoktāṃ kriyāṃ cikitsāṃ kārayet | etena tāni lakṣaṇāni atrā'pi jñeyāni iti granthakṛtā sūcitam | tathāhi -‘tarpaṇaṃ puṭapākaṃ ca nasyārhe na ca yojayet | yāvantyahāni yuñjīta dvistato hitabhāk bhavet’ iti || 52-61 ||
Gū. atha puṭapākaḥ | ataḥ ūrdhvam ataḥ paraṃ puṭapākasya sādhanaṃ vakṣyāmi kathayiṣyāmi | tatsādhanamāha - māṃsasya jāṅgalamāṃsasya bilvamātrau dvau piṇḍau snigdhau sucikkaṇau tathā supeṣitau sūkṣmapeṣitau bilvadravyāṇāṃ śuṣkāṇāṃ bilvamātraṃ dravaḥ kuḍavayutaḥ | phalaṃ tanmāṃsauṣadham ekatvaṃ samāloḍya samyak melayitvā patrairjambvādibhirveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ mṛttikāṃ veṣṭya puṭapākayuktyā tadrasaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | tarpaṇoktavidhānena avacārayet | tasya grahaṇavidhānamāha - saḥ snehādibhedena tridhābhūtaḥ | uttānaśāyino nityaṃ niṣevyaḥ syāt tasya kiṃvidho hitastadāha - sugamam | snehamāha - sarpirghṛtaṃ māṃsādīni medāṃtāni jāṅgalāni svādvauṣadhaiḥ kākolyādibhiḥ kṛtasnehanastena puṭapākaḥ īdṛśaḥ iṣyate vāṅmātrā dve śate dhāryāḥ | lekhanamāha - lekhanadravyāṇi kṛṣṇalohādīni kṛṣṇaloharajaścūrṇaṃ siṃdhusrotoñjanaḥ cūrṇaṃ dadhimastu dadhijalaṃ lekhano vāk śataṃ dhāryaḥ | etāvadeva tasya dhāraṇam | atha ropaṇamāha - stanyaṃ dugdhaṃ jāṅgalaṃ jāṅgalamāṃsaṃ madhu kṣaudram ājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tiktakadravyāṇi kaṭukyādīni taiḥ pācitaḥ lekhanāt | ropaṇaḥ triguṇapramāṇo dhāryaḥ | lekhane vākśatādidhāraṇaṃ vyāpattidarśane upadrave tarpaṇoktāṃ kriyāṃ vitaret || 52-61 ||
añjanam | atha saṃpakvadoṣasya prāptamañjanamācaret | hemante śiśire caiva madhyāhne'ñjanamiṣyate ||62|| pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇe ca grīṣme śaradi ceṣyate | varṣāsu nābhre nāpyuṣṇe vasante ca sadaiva hi ||63|| lekhanaṃ ropaṇaṃ caiva tathā syātsnehanāñjanam | lekhanaṃ kṣāratīkṣṇāmlarasairañjanamiṣyate || 64 || kaṣāyatiktarasayuksasnehaṃ ropaṇaṃ matam | madhuraṃ snehasaṃpannamañjanaṃ tu prasādanam ||95 || guṭikārasacūrṇāṃni trividhānyañjanāni ca | kuryācchalākayā'ṅgulyā hīnāni ca athottaram ||66|| śrānte prarudite bhīte pītamadye navajvare | ajīrṇe vegaghāte ce nāñjanaṃ saṃpraśasyate || 67|| hareṇumātrāṃ kurvīta vārtiṃ tīkṣṇāñjane bhiṣak | pramāṇaṃ madhyame'dhyardhaṃ dviguṇaṃ tu mṛdau bhavet ||68|| rasakriyā tūttamā syāttriviḍaṅgamitā hitā | madhyamā dviviḍaṅgā syāddhīnā tvekaviḍaṅgikā ||69|| vairecanekacūrṇaṃ tu dviśalākaṃ vidhīyate | mṛdau tu triśalākaṃ syāccatasra: snaihike'ñjane ||70|| mukhayoḥ kuṇṭhitā ślakṣṇā śalākāṣṭāṅgulonmitā | aśmajā dhātujā vā syātkalāyaparimaṇḍalā ||71|| tāmralohāśmasaṃjātā śalākā lekhane matā | suvarṇarajatodbhūtā śalākā snehane matā || 72 || aṅgulīva mṛdutvena kathitā ropaṇe budhaiḥ | sāyaṃ prātarvāñjanaṃ syāttatsadā naiva kārayet ||73|| nātiśītoṣṇavātābhravelāyāṃ saṃpraśasyate | kṛṣṇabhāgādadhaḥ kuryādapāṅgaṃ yāvadañjanam || 74 ||
Dī. atha añjanaprakāramāha - athaśabdo'trāmadoṣānantaraṃ sūcyate | tenāparipakvadoṣasya prāptamañjanamapraśastamityabhiprāyaḥ | yataḥ ‘añjanaṃ pūraṇaṃ kkāthapānamāme na śasyata’ iti | prāptamañjanamiti yadyasya samayasyoktaṃ tattatraiva yojyamiti prāptaśabdena varṇitam | atha kathamācarettadāha - hemanta ityādyaṃ janaviṣayaṃ sāmānyaṃ viśeṣo yathā | atha trividhāñjanamāha -śukrādiṣu ropaṇaṃ kledakaṇḍūpakṣmaprarohaṇādiṣu snehanaṃ dṛṣṭiprasādanaṃ tacca timirādiṣu atha trayāṇāṃ sāmānyena dravyāṇyāha - kṣārādivastunirmitaṃ lekhanāñjanaṃ kathitaṃ kṣāraṃ yavakṣāraprabhṛtikaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ maricādikam amlarasam amlīkamātuluṅgapramukhaṃ ropaṇāñjanaṃ tu | kaṣāyādinirmitaṃ bhavati | kaṣāyo harītakyādiḥ tikto nimbādiḥ | sasnehamiti | snehaṃ ghṛtatailādikaṃ prasādāñjanaṃ tu snehanasaṃjñaṃ kathitam | tattu madhurādinirmitaṃ bhavati | madhuraṃ madhurarasaprāyaṃ dravyam | madhuraṃ ghṛtaguḍādisnehasaṃpannamiti snehārtham | ata eva snehanaṃ kathitam | atha trividhāñjanasya rūpamāha -guṭikārasacūrṇādīnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyam | tattrividhaṃ tu śalākayā aṅgulyā vā yathāyogyaṃ kuryāt | añjanamiti tāni yathottaraṃ tu hīnāni jñātavyāni yo yasmāduttaraṃ yathottaraṃ tena guṭikāñjanādrasakriyāñjanaṃ hīnaṃ rasāccūrṇāñjanamiti | atha yeṣāṃ rogiṇāmañjanaṃ na praśastaṃ tānāha -śrānte puruṣe | śrāntatā ca chardanavāhanajā bhavati | prarudite prakarṣarodane kṛte | bhīte bhayayukte pītamadye pītaṃ madyaṃ yena ajīrṇe āmājīrṇe viṣṭabdhe tu śūlādau vihitametat | vegāghāte mūtrapurīṣādīnāṃ cakārādbhuktavati rātrijāgaraṇe ca nāñjanaṃ vihitaṃ tathācoktam - ‘bhuktavāṃstu śiraḥsnātaśrāntaśchardanavāhanai: | rātrau jāgaritaścāpi nātijvarita eva ce’ti | athāñjanasya parimāṇamāha - hareṇumātramiti | hareṇustripuṭaḥ | kalāyaḥ reṇuketyapare | madhyame'ñjane sārdhaikapramāṇaṃ yathā syādvartiṃ kuryādityabhiprāyaḥ | mṛdāvityañjane dviguṇaṃ hareṇudvayaṃ yathā syāttathā vartiṃ kuryāditi śeṣaḥ | atha rasakriyāñjanamāha - rasakriyā vakṣyamāṇāñjanasamūhāñjanaviśeṣo'vagantavyaḥ | uttamamātrā mṛdvañjano viḍaṅgo dravyaviśeṣo vyākhyātaḥ | madhyameti na tīkṣṇe mṛduriti hīneti tīkṣṇāñjana ityarthaḥ | ekaviḍaṅgaparimitā rasakriyā vartermātrā boddhavyā | taduktaṃ - ‘viḍaṅgamātraṃ tvapare madhyaṃ dvāvuttamatrayaṃ | rasakriyāṇāṃ vartīnāṃ pramāṇaṃ parikīrtitam’ iti | athāparāñjanānāṃ mānamanyattadāha - vairecanikaṃ cūrṇamañjanaprastāve boddhavyaṃ | tacca tīkṣṇāñjanaṃ kathitam ata eva dviśalākonmitameva mṛdāviti mṛducūrṇāñjane snehaneñjane catasraḥ śalākāḥ | tena catuḥśalākonmitāñjanaṃ proktamityarthaḥ | śalākālakṣaṇaṃ vidhānamapi vakṣyamāṇaṃ boddhavyam | athāñjanaśalākāmāha – mukhayoriti | śalākāyā ūrdhvādhobhāgagatayoreva mukhaśabdo vācyaḥ | tau tu kuṇṭhitau vigatadhārau kuryādityabhiprāyaḥ | tena mukulākārāvityapare | tathāca ‘vakrāṃte mukulākārā kalāyaparimaṇḍale’tyādi | ślakṣṇeti | sarvatraiva ślakṣṇā kāryā mṛdutvena sasnigdhetyarthaḥ | aṣṭāṅgulonmitā aṣṭabhiraṅgulaiḥ kṛtvā parimitā kāryā aśmajā sphaṭikādipāṣāṇaracitā | na kevalaṃ pāṣāṇajanitā dhātujā vā | dhātuśabdena suvarṇādikaṃ gṛhyate | tena suvarṇaraupyatāmrakāṣṭhāsthimayāḥ | kṛtā śalākā añjane śastā aṣṭāṅgulamitā śubhā iti | kalāyaparimaṇḍaletyanena parisamantādvartulā kāryā ityabhiprāyaḥ| kalāyo vartulakalāyaḥ || asyāgre keciditi paṭhanti ‘vāme karatale kṛtvā sajalaṃ nikaṣopalam | dakṣiṇenāñjanaṃ nītvā kareṇa nikaṣecchanaiḥ || tena kalkena matimān śalākāgraṃ pralipya ca | utthāpya cottaraṃ vartma vāmenāṅguṣṭhaparvaṇā || vartma śuklāntare cālpāṃ śalākāṃ supravartayet | prathamaṃ savyanetraṃ ca paścādañjyāttu dakṣiṇaṃ | śalākāṃguṣṭhadeśinyā navāṃtarnayanaṃ spṛśet’ ityādi kaiścittaṃtrāntarādavagamyātra likhitaṃ na svamataṃ | lekhane lekhanāñjane snehane snehanāñjane | ropaṇe ropaṇāṃjane | ropaṇāñjanaṃ tu dṛṣṭisādanaṃ | budhairiti grahaṇena yathāyogyam anyavastujanitā śalākā yojyā | athāñjanakarmaṇaḥ kālamāha - sāyaṃprātaḥ ityanena sāyaṃ tīkṣṇāṃjanaṃ kuryāt | prātaḥ gaṇḍūṣānantaraṃ yathā sadācāre rasāṃjanādikaṃ tadvadanyadapi sadā sarvakāle tadañjanaṃ na kārayedityarthaḥ | yataḥ | cakṣustejomayaṃ tasya viśeṣāt | ‘yojayetsaptarātre tu sravaṇārthe rasāñjanami’ti | tīkṣṇāñjanaṃ yathā ‘divā na tu prayoktavyaṃ netrayostīkṣṇamañjanaṃ | virekadurbalā dṛṣṭirādityaṃ prāpya sīdati | tasmāt sāyaṃ niśāyāṃ tu dhruvamañjanamiṣyate | rātrau svapnaguṇādakṣipuṣṭā hyañjanakarṣiteti’ | na kevalaṃ sarvakālaṃ niṣiddhaṃ kiṃtu yadā atiśītoṣṇavātābhraṃ ca bhavati tadā tasyāṃ velāyāmapi nāñjanaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ | kutra sthāneñjanaṃ kuryāttadāha - kṛṣṇabhāgādityādi sugamam || 62-74 ||
Gū. athāñjanaṃ atha athānantaraṃ pakkadoṣasya puruṣasya divasapañcakānantaram āgatapāke'kṣṇi añjanam ācaret | idānīṃ sādhāraṇāñjanavidhimāha - hemante ityādau | hemante śiśire madhyāhneñjanam iṣyate grīṣme śaradi ca pūrvāhṇe aparāhṇe varṣāsu anabhre abhrarahite | nātyuṣṇe na uṣṇasamaye vasante sadaiva iṣyate | lekhanādibhedenāñjanabhedānāha - lekhanaṃ ropaṇaṃ ca prasādanaṃ cetyaṃjanabhedaḥ | lekhanaṃ tatra kṣārādirasaiḥ kaṣāyādibhiḥ | prasādanaṃ guṭikādibhiḥ | trividhamañjanamāha - guṭikādīni trividhānyaṃjanāni śalākayā aṅgulyā vā kriyate | yeṣu añjanaṃ na deyaṃ tānāha - vegaghāte | mūtrādyavarodhe vartyādau | añjanapramāṇaṃ tīkṣṇe'ñjane hareṇumātrāṃ vartiṃ kurvīta | hareṇu reṇukā kalāpo vā madhyame tīkṣṇānmadhyārdhāṃ hareṇumātrātaḥ ardhārdhaṃ sā hareṇumātrā mṛdau tīkṣṇānmṛdau dviguṇaṃ hareṇuto dviguṇaṃ sakriyā | uttamādi pramāṇamāha - sugamam | vairecanādau kiyantyaḥ śalākā ityāha -yato vairecanikaṃ cūrṇaṃ netre bahusrāvakaraṃ tadvairecanikam añjanaṃ vāradvayaṃ śalākayā dīyate | snehakāle catasra: śalākā vidhīyante | śalākāpramāṇaṃ yathā kasya śalāketi | ca mukhayodvaryoḥ | kuṇṭhitā ślakṣṇā śalākāṅgulonmitā | mukhayordvayoḥ kuṇṭhitā na tīkṣṇā ślakṣṇā sundarā aṣṭāṅgulonmitā aṣṭāṅgulapramāṇā aśmajā pāṣāṇajā dhātujā svarṇādidhātujā kalāyaparimaṇḍalā | kalāyo vartulakastatparimāṇā sthūlā | lekhanādau kīdṛśī śalākā vidhīyate tāmāha - sugamam | kasminkasmin samaye kasmin bhāge añjanaṃ kuryādityāha - sāyaṃsaṃdhyāyāṃ prātaḥ vā añjanaṃ syāt | añjanaṃ tadā na kārayet | tat añjanam atiśītoṣṇavātābhravelāyāṃ na praśasyate | atiśīte atyuṣṇe kāle nāñjanaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ || 62-74 ||
pūrvamuktaṃ lekhanaropaṇasnehanabhedena trividhāñjaneṣu vartirasacūrṇatrividharūpaṃ, tatrādau lekhanīvartiradhunā vidhīyase | candrodayā | śaṅkhanābhirvibhītasya majjā pathyā manaḥśilā | pippalī maricaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vacā ceti samāṃśakam ||75|| chāgīkṣīreṇa saṃpiṣya vartiṃ kṛtvā yavonmitām | hareṇumātrāṃ saṃghṛṣya jalaiḥ kuryādathāñjanam || 76 || timiraṃ māṃsavṛddhiṃ ca kācaṃ paṭalamarbudam | rātryāndhyaṃ vārṣikaṃ puṣpaṃ vartiścandrodayā jayet ||77||
Dī. iyaṃ candrodayā vartirlekhanī kathitā | rātryañjanayogena candrodayābhidhānamasyāḥ | tīkṣṇāñjanatvāt | śaṅkhanābhiriti madhye āvartatvena laghucakrākāraṃ dravyaviśeṣaṃ samudrajaṃ śaṃkhaṃ śaṅkhanābhiśabdena vācyam1 | athavā śaṅkhasya nābhirmadhye grāhyam | atinirmalatvāt | vibhītakasya vibhītakaphalamajjā pathyā harītakī | yavonmiteti | yavaparimāṇāṃ vartiṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | añjanārthaṃ tu hareṇumātrā saṃghṛṣyāñjayet | lekhanāñjanatvāt jalairityanena pūrvaṃ vartiḥ kṣīreṇa saṃpiṣya kāryā paścādañjanasamaye pānīyena saha ghṛṣyāñjayediti bhāvaḥ | māṃsavṛddhirarmādijanitā śeṣaṃ sugamam || 75-77 ||
Gū. atha vartiḥ | śaṅkhanābhiḥ śaṅkhamadhyabhāgā | etānsaṃpiṣya yavonmitāṃ vartiṃ kuryāt | hareṇumātrāṃ reṇukāmātrāṃ saṃghṛṣya añjanaṃ kuryāt | asyāñjanasya candrodayāvartiriti saṃjñā timirādīn jayet | vārṣikaṃ puṣpaṃ varṣaprabhavaṃ jayet | iti candrodayāvartiḥ || 75-77 ||
karañjavartiḥ | palāśapuṣpasvarasairbahuśaḥ2 paribhāvitā | karañjabījavartistu dṛṣṭeḥ puṣpaṃ vināśayet ||78||
Dī. atha puṣpārthalekhanīvartidvayamāha - palāśapuṣpaṃ kiṃśukābhidhānaṃ bahuśaḥ ityanena saptavāramityabhiprāyaḥ | karañjabījavartiriti| karañjo bṛhatkarañjaḥ ||78||
Gū. atha lekhanīvartiḥ palāśapuṣpasvarasena karañjī bījareṇuḥ bahuśaḥ bhāvitā tadvartiḥ śukrādīn samullikhet dūrīkuryāt || 78 ||
samudraphenādivartiḥ | samudraphenasindhūtthaśaṅkhadakṣāṇḍavalkalaiḥ | śigrubījayutairvartiḥ śukādīṃśchastravallikhet || 79 ||
Dī. anyadyogamāha - samudraphenetyādi | samudraphenaṃ prasiddhaṃ sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ śaṃkhaṃ prasiddhaṃ dakṣāṇḍavalkalairiti | dakṣaḥ kukkuṭaḥ tasyāṃḍatvageva grāhyā | eke samudraphena ityādikaṃ viparītaṃ paṭhanti tadyathā - ‘samudraphenadakṣāṇḍatvaksindhūtthaiḥ samākṣikaiḥ |3 śigrubījayutairvartiḥ śukraghnī śigruvāriṇe’ti | vyākhyānayanti tatra mākṣikaṃ dhātumākṣikaṃ śigruvāriṇā śigrusvarasena śastravallekhanena lekhanī kathitā || 79 ||
Gū. anyacca samudraphenaśaṅkhadakṣāṇḍakukkuṭāṇḍavalkalaiḥ śigru śobhāñjanaṃ tadbījaiḥ tadvartiḥ śukraṃ puṣpaṃ lekhanī vartiḥ || 79 ||
dantavartiḥ | dantairdantivarāhoṣṭragohayājakhurodbhavaiḥ | śaṅkhamuktāmbhodhiphenayutaiḥ sarvairvicūrṇitaiḥ4 || 80 || dantavartiḥ kṛtā ślakṣṇā śukrāṇāṃ nāśinī parā |
Dī. atha lekhanīdantavartimāha - dantī hastīti rūḍhiḥ, varāhaḥ śūkaraḥ, uṣṭraḥ kramelako'pi govṛṣabho'pi, hayo ghoṭakaḥ, ajo bastaḥ chāgasaṃjñaḥ | kharo gardabhaḥ eteṣāṃ dantairityarthaḥ | kathaṃbhūtaiḥ śaṅkhamuktāmbhodhiphenayutairiti | śaṅkhaśabdena sarvatra śaṅkhanābhirgrāhyā | muktā mauktikaṃ ambhodhiphenaṃ samudraphenaṃ ślakṣṇā iti sūkṣmatvena saṃsnigdhā yathā syāt | parā utkṛṣṭā atrānukte peṣaṇārthaṃ jalameva grāhyam || 80 ||
Gū. atha lekhanī dantavartiḥ dantī hastī tadādīnāṃ dantaiḥ ajaḥ chāgaḥ kharo gardabha ambhodhiphenaṃ samudraphenaṃ | dantavartiḥ lekhanīvartiḥ || 80 ||
nīlotpalavartiḥ | nīlotpalaṃ śigrubījaṃ nāgakeśarakaṃ tathā || 81 || etatkalkaiḥ kṛtā vartiratinidrāṃ nivārayet |
Dī. nīlotpalamityādi | iyamapi lekhanīvartiḥ kathitā | nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalaṃ tadabhāve padmabījaṃ grāhyamiti | sarvatra kalkārthamatra jalamāhuḥ | anuktatvāt || 81 ||
puṣpavartiḥ | tilapuṣpāṇyaśītiḥ syuḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ pippalitaṃḍulāḥ ||82|| jātī kusuma pañcāśanmaricāni ca ṣoḍaśa | sūkṣmaṃ piṣṭvā jale vartiḥ kṛtā kusumikābhidhā ||83|| timirārjunaśukrāṇāṃ nāśinī māṃsavṛddhihṛt | (etasyāścāñjane mātrā5 proktā sārdhahareṇukā ||84||)
Dī. idānīṃ ropaṇīvartividhānamāha - tileti | iyaṃ ropaṇī kusumikāvartiḥ kathitā | atra tilapuṣpāṇi aśītisaṃkhyākāni pippalītaṃḍulāḥ pippalīmadhyagatabījāni sarṣapākārāṇi ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyākāni grāhyāṇi | jātī sumanāḥ tasyāḥ puṣpāṇyapi pañcāśadgaṇitāni maricāni ca ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyākānītyarthaḥ | jalairiti bahuvacanatvena kutrāpi kṣīreṇa pracāraḥ | timiropalakṣitatvena gataṃ cakṣuḥ nivartayedityapi yojyaṃ ropaṇatvāt | kecidasyāgre iti paṭhanti | etasyāścāñjane mātrā proktā sārdhahareṇukā etatpūrvaṃ kathitameva tasmādbahubhirna svīkṛtaṃ paunaruktyabhayāt | eke ṣaṣṭiḥ pippalitaṃḍulā ityasya sthāne ‘ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyāḥ kaṇāḥ smṛtā’ iti paṭhanti etanna manoharam || 82-84 ||
Gū. atha ropaṇīvartiḥ | aśītiḥ tilapuṣpāṇi | kaṇā pippalī tasyāḥ kaṇikāḥ ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyāḥ | jātīmukulāni puṣpāṇi pañcāśat | iyaṃ kusumikā vartiḥ | tasyā mātrā sārdhahareṇukā | kusumikā vartistimirādau || 82-84 ||
rasāñjanavartiḥ | rasāñjanaṃ haridre dve mālatīnimbapallavā: | gośakṛdrasasaṃyuktā vartirnaktāndhyanāśinī || 85 ||
Dī. athānyāṃ ropaṇīvartimāha - rasāñjanaṃ kṛṣṇapāṣāṇākṛtidhātudravyaṃ tadabhāve dārvīkvāthasamudbhavaṃ grāhyaṃ | haridre dve haridrā dāruharidrā mālatīpallavā nimbapallavā iti | mālatī jātī nimbaḥ prasiddhaḥ etayoḥ pallavāni komalapatrāṇi | gośakṛdrasa iti gopurīṣasvarasaḥ | śakṛdityasya sthāne yakṛditi pāṭhāntaram || 85 ||
Gū. rasāñjanaṃ dve haridre haridrā, dāruharidrā, mālatī jātī nimbaḥ tayoḥ pallavāḥ komalapatrāṇi gośakṛt gopurīṣaṃ tadrasaṃ jalaṃ tena vartiḥ kṛtā naktāndhyaṃ rātryāndhyaṃ jayet || 85 ||
dhātryādivartiḥ | dhātryakṣapathyābījāni ekadvitriguṇāni ca | piṣṭvā vartiṃ jalaiḥ kuryādañjanaṃ dvihareṇukam || 86 || netrasrāvaṃ haratyāśu vātaraktarujaṃ tathā6 |
Dī. idānīṃ snehanīvartiṃ darśayannāha - dhātryakṣeti | iyaṃ snehanī vartiḥ kathitā | ekadvitriguṇāni yathākramaṃ yojyāni | vātaruktarajaṃ tathetyanena vātajanitāṃ raktajanitāmabhiṣyandādīnāṃ rujaṃ haratītyanye vyākhyānayanti | saṃmatoyamanyatroktatvāt | yathā ‘pathyākṣadhātrīphalamadhyabījaistridvyekabhāgairvidadhīta vartiḥ | tathāñjayedaśrumatipravṛddhamakṣṇorharet kaṣṭamapi prakopamiti ||86||
Gū. dhātrī āmalakī akṣaṃ vibhītakaṃ pathyā harītakī krameṇa ekadvitriguṇāni etāni dvihareṇumātram añjanaṃ kuryāt | netrasrāvaṃ harati snehanī vartikā netrasrāve || 86 ||
rasakriyā | tutthamākṣikasindhūtthaṃ sitāśaṅkamanaḥśilāḥ ||87|| gairikodadhiphenaṃ ca maricaṃ ceti cūrṇayet | saṃyojya madhunā kuryādañjanārthaṃ rasakriyām || 88 || vartmarogārmatimirakācaśukraharāṃ parām |
Dī. atha rasakriyāmāha - iyaṃ ca lekhanīsaṃjñakā rasakriyāñjanārthaṃ vihitā, atra tu mākṣikaṃ dhātumākṣikaṃ, sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ, sitā śarkarā, śaṅkaṃ śaṅkhanābhi:, udadhiphenaṃ - samudraphenaṃ ceti cūrṇayediti | anena samānamānameteṣāṃ grāhyam | saṃyojya madhunā kuryāditi ko'rthaḥ | etaccūrṇaṃ madhūktaśalākayā saṃgṛhya śukrādideśaṃ gharṣayedityabhiprāyaḥ | madhuplāvitāṃ vartimāhureke ||87-88||
Gū. atha lekhanīrasakriyā tutthaṃ mākṣikaṃ svarṇamākṣikaṃ, sindhūtthaṃ saindhavaṃ, sitā sitopalaṃ, śaṃkhaṃ, manaḥśilā, gairikam, udadhiphenaṃ, maricaṃ, madhunāñjanam imāṃ rasakriyāṃ rasānāṃ tutthakadīnāṃ kriyā rasakriyā, yadvā rasaviśiṣṭā yataḥ puṣpaharī rasakriyāyāṃ dhātuḥ nāsti karpūramevāsti || 87-88 ||
tathāca lekhanī rasakriyā -- vaṭakṣīreṇa saṃyukto mukhyaḥ karpūrajaḥ kaṇaḥ || 89 || kṣipramañjanato hanti kusumaṃ tu dvimāsikam |
Dī. athāparāṃ lekhanīṃ rasakriyāmāha - karpūrajaḥ kaṇaḥ karpūrajaḥ śakalaḥ tena karpūraśakalaṃ saṃgṛhya vaṭakṣīreṇa saha saṃghṛṣyāñjayedityarthaḥ | mukhya ityuttamaḥ | yataḥ kaṃrpūrastrividho bhavati | tadyathā ‘īśāvāso himasaṃjñaḥ potāsa iti sa tridhā | apakve kathyate bhedaḥ karpūre tu bhiṣagvaraiḥ’ | lakṣaṇenāpi ‘īśāvāso bhṛśaṃ śveto himasaṃjñastathāṅkura: | śvetaḥ potāśrayaḥ sarve rasavīryavipākataḥ | prabhāvenāpi te proktāḥ pūrvapūrvaguṇādhikāḥ | tatrāpi yo navakṣudra: sphaṭikābhaḥ sa uttamaḥ’ iti mukhyaśabdena vyākhyātaḥ | eke ‘vaṭakṣīreṇa saṃyuktaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ karpūrajaṃ rajaḥ | kṣipramañjanato hanti tamaḥ sūryodayādiva’ iti paṭhanti || 89 ||
Gū. atha puṣpaharī rasakriyā sugamam || 89 ||
atinidrāyāṃ yogaḥ - kṣaudrāśvalālāsaṃghṛṣṭairmaricairnetramañjayet ||90|| atinidrā śamaṃ yāti tamaḥ sūryodayādiva |
Dī. kṣaudraṃ madhu aśvalālā ghoṭakavaktrajanito dravaviśeṣaḥ | atinidrāpi sannipātajvarajanitā boddhavyā | iyamapi lekhanī rasakriyā kathitā || 90 ||
Gū. athātinidrāyāmañjanaṃ sugamam || 90 ||
prabodhanāñjanam | jātīpuṣpaṃ pravālaṃ ca maricaṃ kaṭukī vacā || 91 || saindhavaṃ bastamūtreṇa piṣṭaṃ tandrāghnamañjanam | śirīṣabījagomūtrakṛṣṇāmaricasaindhavaiḥ || 92 || añjanaṃ syātprabodhāya sarasonaśilāvacaiḥ |
Dī. tatra jātīpuṣpaṃ, mālatīpuṣṣaṃ, pravālaṃ vidrumaṃ kaṭukā kaṭurohiṇī, bastamūtraṃ chāgamūtram | śeṣaṃ subodham | iyamapi gomūtreṇa kalkīkṛtya vartisvarūpā lekhinī rasakriyā kathitā | athavā kṛṣṇā pippalī | kathaṃbhūtaiḥ śirīṣabījādibhiḥ sarasonaśilāvacairiti | rasono hlasunavācyaḥ | śilā manaḥśilā vacā vikhyātā etāni dravyāṇi atra godhūmaṃ vihāya samamātrāṇi grāhyāṇi | gomūtramānaṃ tu kalkārthaṃ yāvat | prabodhāyetyanena sannipātajvarajanitaṃ tandrīvināśanāyāñjanamatrāhuḥ || 91 -92 ||
Gū. atha nidrāyāmañjanaṃ, jātī mālatī tasyāḥ puṣpaṃ, pravālaṃ vidrumaṃ, kaṭukī vacā | bastaśchāgastanmūtreṇāñjanaṃ, atha sannipāteñjanam | śirīṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ | tadbījaṃ kṛṣṇā pippalī rasonaḥ lasunaḥ śilā manaḥśilā vacā etairañjanam || 91-92 ||
dārvyādirasakriyā | dārvī paṭolaṃ madhukaṃ sanimbapadmakotpalam || 93 || prapauṇḍarīkaṃ caitāni pacettoye caturguṇe | vipācya pādaśeṣaṃ tu śṛtaṃ nītvā punaḥ pacet ||94|| śīte tasminmadhu sitāṃ dadyātpādāṃśikāṃ nara: | rasakriyaiṣā dāhāśruraktarāgarujo haret || 95 ||
Dī. idānīṃ lekhinīrasakriyāmabhidhāya ropaṇīrasakriyāmāha - dārvīti | dārvī dāruharidrā, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ| padmākha iti loke | yatra padmamasti tatra kamalaṃ grāhyaṃ sarvatra, kamalā'bhāve padmabījamiti | sarvatracaturguṇatā ca kvāthyadravyāṇām | kkāthyadravyaṃ tu dārvyādikaṃ ca samamātraṃ deyaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ caturthaṃ suśṛtaṃ kvathitaṃ tacca pādaśeṣaṃ punaḥ pacedityarthaḥ | sāndrībhūte himasadṛśe tasmin | sitā madhu ca melayitvā pādāṃśaṃ kṣipediti | pādāṃśaṃ kkāthaśeṣāt | nara iti vaidyaḥ | iti ropaṇī rasakriyā proktā | dāhādayo'tra netrasyeti saṃbandhaḥ || 93-95||
Gū. atha ropaṇīrasakriyā | dārvī dāruharidrā, paṭolaṃ, madhukaṃ, yaṣṭī, nimbaṃ, padmakam, utpalaṃ kamalaṃ prapauṃḍarīkaṃ tadraktam; etāni tulyāni caturguṇe toye jale pacet | caturthāṃśaṃ śṛtaṃ kkāthaṃ nītvā punaḥ pacet | madhusitā sitotpalam | pādāṃśaṃ kkāthāt | eṣā rasakriyā dāhādiharī rasarūpaikā kriyā rasakriyā | yadvā rasānāṃ tutthādidhātūnāṃ kriyā rasakriyā | yadvā dravyāṇāṃ kriyā rasakriyā aśrusrāvādau || 93-95 ||
rasāñjanādirasakriyā | rasājanaṃ sarjaraso jātīpuṣpaṃ manaḥśilā | samudrapheno lavaṇaṃ gairikaṃ maricāni ca ||96|| etatsamāṃśaṃ madhunā piṣṭvā praklinnavartmani | añjanaṃ kledakaṇḍūghnaṃ pakṣmaṇāṃ ca prarohaṇam || 97 ||
Dī. iyamapi ropaṇīrasakriyāñjanasamūhe vihitā | tatra rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthodbhavaṃ, sarjaraso'gnivallabhaḥ | loke rāla iti | lavaṇamatra saindhavaṃ netrahitatvāt | tathāca - ‘madhu yavapādāsaṃga: śatāvarīmudgasaindhavāmalakī cakṣuṣya: saṃkṣepādvargaḥ kathito bhiṣagbhirayam’ iti | śeṣaṃ sugamam ||96-97||
Gū. atha pakṣmaprarohaṇādau kriyā | rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkkāthodbhavam | sarjaraso rālaḥ | jātī mālatī tatpuṣpaṃ praklinnavartmani, kledaḥ klinnatā, spaṣṭamanyat ||96-97||
guḍūcīsvarasaḥ karṣaḥ kṣaudraṃ syānmāṣakonmitam | saindhavaṃ kṣaudratulyaṃ syātsarvamekatra mardayet || 98 || añjayennayanaṃ tena pillārmatimiraṃ jayet | kācaṃ kaṇḍūṃ liṅganāśaṃ śuklakṛṣṇagatāngadān ||99 ||
Dī. athānyā ropaṇī rasakriyā api darśayannāha - guḍūcītyanena | latāyāḥ sadyo rasaḥ saindhavaṃ kṣaudratulyamiti | kṣaudratulyaṃ māṣaparimitaṃ mardanamasya kāṃsye tāmraje vā pātre ityasmadīyasaṃpradāyaḥ | śeṣaṃ subodham || 98 || 99 ||
Gū. atha pakṣmarogādau timirādau armamasūratimirādau
punarnavārasakriyā | dugdhena kaṇḍūṃ kṣaudreṇa netrasrāvaṃ ca sarpiṣā | puṣpaṃ tailena timiraṃ kāñjikena niśāndhatām ||10.|| punarnavā jayedāśu bhāskastimiraṃ yathā |
Dī. atra kṣīrādīnāṃ vyastena kṛtvā sarvaropaṇī rasakriyā jñātavyā dugdhasya strībhavaṃ sarpiratrājaṃ gavyaṃ vā tailaṃ tilasaṃbhavaṃ kāñjikaṃ śuktaviśeṣaṃ prasiddham | punarnaveti punarnavāsvarasaḥ || 10. ||
Gū. atha punarnavānupānamañjane punarnavā dugdhādinā kaṇḍvādīn jayet yathā bhāskarastimiram ||10.||
babbūlarasakiyā | babbūladalani:kātho lehībhūtastadañjanāt || 101 || netrasrāvaṃ jayatyeṣa madhuyukto na saṃśayaḥ | hiñjalarasakriyā | hiñjalasya phalaṃ ghṛṣṭvā pānīye nityamañjanam ||102|| cakṣu:srāvopaśāntyarthaṃ kāryametanmahauṣadham |
Dī. babbūladalāccaturguṇaṃ pānīyaṃ datvā niḥkkāthya pādaśeṣaṃ paṭe visrāvya nītā punarvipacet yāvat sāndro bhavati | paścāt pādayuktena madhunā saṃsrāvyāñjayedityabhiprāya: | iyamapi ropaṇī rasakriyā vyākhyātā | hiñjalasya phalaṃ katakaphalamiti prasiddham | etanmahauṣadhamiti mahāñjanavarametadityartha: | ayamapi yogo ropaṇīrasakriyāyāṃ kathitaḥ ||101||102||
Gū. atha netrasrāve'nyaḥ prayogaḥ sugamam | babbūladalaṃ patraṃ tasya kvātho lehībhūtaḥ lehākārastasyāñjanaṃ hijjalo hiṃgoṭhaḥ tatpalaṃ pṛṣṭvā ghṛṣṭvā pānīyenāñjanam || 101 || 102 || idānīṃ snehanī rasakriyā
idānīṃ snehanī rasakriyā katakarasakriyā | katakasya phalaṃ ghṛṣṭvā madhunā netramañjayet || 103 || īṣatkarpūrasahitaṃ smṛtaṃ netraprasādanam |
Dī. netraprasādanaṃ dṛṣṭisādanam | tasyāḥ prasannatvena netrasyā'pi prasannatvam | tathācoktaṃ dṛṣṭāntena yathāhi - ‘kanakasthānāṃ maṇīnāṃ vividhātmanām | dhautānāṃ vimalā śuddhistaile velakarādibhiḥ | evaṃ netreṣu vartyā ca añjanāścyotanādibhiḥ | dṛṣṭirnirākulā bhāti nirmale nabhasīnduvat’ iti || 103 ||
Gū. atha snehanī rasakriyā | katakaphalaṃ nirmalī iti loke prasiddhā | kiṃcit bhīmasenakarpūreṇāñjayet | netraprasādanaṃ netraprasannakaraṃ, netraprasādane || 103 ||
atha śirotpāte rasakriyā | sarpiḥ kṣaudraṃ cāñjanaṃ syācchirotpātasya śāntaye ||104|| gū. - sarpirghṛtam || 104 ||
Gū. sarpirghṛtam || 104 ||
kṛṣṇasarpavasārasakriyā | kṛṣṇasarpavasā śaṅkha: katakātphalamañjanam | rasakriyeyamacirādandhānāṃ darśanapradā || 105 || lekhanāñjanam | dakṣāṇḍatvakśilākācaśaṅkhacandanasaindhavaiḥ | dravyairañjanayogo'yaṃ puṣpārmādivilekhanaḥ || 106 || kaṇārasakriyā | kaṇā chāgayakṛnmadhye paktvā netrayuge'ñjitā | acirāddhanti naktāndhyaṃ tadvatsakṣaudramūṣaṇam ||107|| cūrṇāñjanam| śāṇārdhaṃ maricaṃ dvau ca pippalyarṇavaphenayo: | śāṇārdhaṃ saindhavaṃ śāṇā nava sauvīrakāñjanāt ||108|| piṣṭaṃ susūkṣmaṃ citrāyāṃ cūrṇāñjanamidaṃ śubham | kaṇḍūkācakaphārtānāṃ malānāṃ ca viśodhanam ||109||
Dī. atra vividharasakriyāmamidhāya saṃprati cūrṇāñjanaviṣaye kaiścit pratipāditāmekāṃ rasakriyāmāha - añjanaṃ rasāñjanaṃ śaṅkhaprabhṛtīnāṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā pūrvaṃ sarpavasāktaśalākayā paścāt cūrṇaliptayāñjayediti bhāvaḥ | kutracidrasāñjanaṃ vinā pracarati tatrāñjanaśabdena kajalametat kāryamiti śeṣaḥ || 105 || atha lekhanaṃ cūrṇāñjanamāha - dakṣaḥ kukkuṭaḥ, śilā manaḥśilā, candanamatra raktaṃ netrahitakaratvāt | dakṣāṇḍatvagityādiyogaścūrṇāñjanam | asmatsaṃpradāye tu madhūktaśalākayā ca gṛhītvāñjanaṃ kāryam evaṃ sarvatra | cūrṇāñjane eke saindhavairityasya sthāne gairikairiti paṭhanti, dravyairañjanayogo'yamityasya sthāne tulyaṃ rasāñjanaṃ deyamiti kathayanti | etatpadadvayamapi saṃgataṃ tantrāntaradarśanāt| tathāca - ‘dakṣāṇḍatvakśilāśaṅkhakācacandanagairikaiḥ | tulyaṃ rasāñjanaṃ deyaṃ puṣpārmādivilekhanam’ iti || 106 || aparamapi lekhanāñjanamāha - kaṇā pippalī, chāgayakṛt chāgakālakhaṇḍam | paktvā | kecit ‘paktvā netrayuge'ñjitā’ ityasya sthāne ‘paktvā tadrasapeṣitā’ iti paṭhanti | tatra tadrasapeṣiteti tat svedāmbunā piṣṭvā ityabhiprāyaḥ | tadvaditi chāgayakṛnmadhye ca svinnaṃ tadrasasupiṣṭaṃ ca ūṣaṇaṃ maricaṃ kṣaudramatra yogadvaye'pi pracarati | kecinmadhunā saha bhakṣaṇayogadvayamidamāhuḥ | keṣāṃcinmate yakṛdityupalakṣaṇatvena tallagnaṃ pittaṃ grāhyam | tanmadhye pippalī maricaṃ melayitvā dhāryaṃ paścāt śuṣkaṃ tanmadhunā saṃghṛṣyāñjayediti na svamatam || 107 || athānyacca lekhanāñjanamāha - śāṇārdhaṃ māṣakadvayamitaṃ maricamiti pippalyarṇavaphenayośca dvau śāṇau tena pratyekaṃ śāṇamitamityarthaḥ| arṇavaphenaḥ samudraphenaḥ | eke dvāvityanena militvā śāṇaikamāhuḥ | tanna manoharaṃ | sauvīrakāñcanānnava śāṇā grāhyāḥ | śāṇaṣṭaṅkaḥ kathitaḥ | sa caturmāṣakapramito jñeyaḥ | sauvīrāñjanaṃ suvīrāśabdavācyaṃ tacca kṛṣṇanadīsaṃbhavaṃ bhavati | tadabhāve rasāñjanameva grāhyaṃ, malaśca netrasaṃbhava eva ||108 || 109 ||
Gū. athacūrṇāñjanam | dakṣāṇḍatvak iti | dakṣāṇḍatvak kukkuṭāṇḍavalkalaṃ śilā manaḥśilā, kācaṃ śvetakācaṃ śaṅkhaṃ candanaṃ saindhavam ebhirdravyaiḥ piṣṭairayamañjanayogaḥ puṣpādilekhanaḥ | puṣpādau naktāndhye - kaṇā pippalī chāgayakṛnmadhye paktvā punastadrasapeṣitā tadrasaḥ yakṛdrasaḥ | acirāt śīghreṇa naktāndhyaṃ rātrau dṛṣṭimandatāṃ hanti | tadvat ūṣaṇaṃ maricaṃ ca kṛtam | sakṣaudraṃ madhusahitam | naktāndhye cūrṇāñjanaṃ cūrṇarūpamañjanaṃ cūrṇāñjanam | arṇavaphenaṃ samudraphenaṃ maricaṃ śāṇārdhaṃ pippalyarṇavaphenayordvau śāṇau pratyekaṃ śāṇāṣṭakaḥ saindhavam ardhaśāṇaṃ sauvīrakāñjanaṃ navaśāṇaṃ citrāyāṃ citrānakṣatre sūkṣmaṃ piṣṭhaṃ śubhaṃ cūrṇāñjanaṃ bhavati | kaṇḍvādau ||105- 109 ||
idānīṃ ropaṇacūrṇāñjanamāha - (mṛducūrṇāñjanam) śilāyāṃ rasakaṃ piṣṭvā samyagāplāvya vāriṇā | gṛhṇīyāttajjalaṃ sarvaṃ tyajeccūrṇamadhogatam || 110 || śuṣkaṃ ca tajjalaṃ sarvaṃ parpaṭīsaṃnibhaṃ bhavet | vicūrṇya bhāvayetsamyaktrivelaṃ triphalārasaiḥ || 111|| karpūrasya rajastatra daśamāṃśena nikṣipet | añjayennayane tena sarvadoṣaharaṃ hi tat || 112 || sarvarogaharaṃ cūrṇaṃ cakṣuṣoḥ sukhakāri ca |
Dī. etanmṛducūrṇāñjanatvena ropaṇatvena kathitaṃ śilāyāṃ rasakaṃ piṣṭvetyādi | śilāyāṃ pāṣāṇaghaṭitā peṣaṇārthaṃ pātraviśeṣaḥ | rasakaṃ kharparakaṃ tacca tutthabhedaḥ | khaparīyāśabdavācyo loke | samyagāplāvya vāriṇā ca | asmāt saṃpradāye tu tadrasakaṃ jalenaiva dṛṣadi saṃpeṣya paścānnirmalapātre bahujale saṃplāvya muhūrtaṃ vilambya tadupari svacchaṃ jalamapanīyādhaḥsthitaṃ tat parpaṭasaṃnibhaṃ dravyaṃ bhavati tadgrāhyamityarthaḥ | karpūracūrṇaṃ tu daśamāṃśaṃ parpaṭīsvarūpadravyāt | sarvadoṣamiti vātapittakapharudhiraṃ | sarvarogamiti netrābhiṣyandādhimanthaprabhṛtikaṃ | cakṣuṣoḥ sukhakārītyanena dṛṣṭiprasādanaṃ kathitam || 110-112 ||
Gū. atha prasādanāñjanaṃ cūrṇam | rasakaṃ kharparaṃ śilāyāṃ piṣṭvā vāriṇā samyak āplāvya cālayitvā vāriṇā jalena tat pātrāntare gṛhṇīyāt | adhogataṃ pāṣāṇādikaṃ tyajet | tat śuṣkaṃ parpaṭīsaṃnibhaṃ punaḥ saṃcūrṇya trivelaṃ triphalārasena bhāvayet | daśamāṃśena karpūrarajaḥ kṣipet | spaṣṭamanyat || 110-112 ||
prasādanāñjanam (sauvīrāñjanam) agnitaptaṃ hi sauvīraṃ niṣiñcettriphalārasaiḥ ||113|| saptavelaṃ tathā stanyaiḥ strīṇāṃ siktaṃ vicūrṇitam | añjayettena nayane pratyahaṃ cakṣuṣorhitam || 114 || sarvānakṣivikārāṃstu hanyādetanna saṃśayaḥ |
Dī. atha snehanābhidhaṃ prasādanasaṃjñakaṃ cūrṇāñjanamāha - agnitaptaṃ sauvīramiti | sauvīraṃ sauvīrāñjanaṃ tacca suramāśabdavācyaṃ triphalā harītakyādikaṃ tasyāḥ sadyo rasaḥ kvathitaraso vā tathetyanena strīdugdhenāpi saptavelamāhuḥ | stanyairiti bahutvenājaṃ gavyaṃ vā kṣīraṃ grāhyaṃ | siktamityatrāpyagnitaptamiti saṃbandhaḥ || 113 || 114 ||
Gū. anyacca sauvīraṃ suramā strīṇāṃ stanyairdugdhaiḥ spaṣṭamanyat || 113 || 114 ||
atha dṛṣṭiprasādanī nāgaśalākā vikhyātā, tāmapi darśayannāha - triphalābhṛṅgaśuṇṭhīnāṃ rasaistadvacca sarpiṣā ||115|| gomūtramadhvajākṣīraiḥ sikto nāgaḥ pratāpitaḥ | tacchalākā haratyeva sarvānnetrabhavāngadān || 116 ||
Dī. tadvadityanena pūrvoktasauvīrāñjanavidhānavadatrāpi | saptavāraṃ pratyekaṃ triphalādidravyeṇa nirvāpaṇamāhuḥ | uktamanyatrāpi - ‘triphalābhṛṅgamahauṣadhasarpirgomūtramadhvajākṣīraiḥ | nāgaṃ saptaniṣiktaṃ karoti garuḍopamaṃ cakṣuḥ’ iti | anyatroktaṃ dṛṣṭāntena draḍhayati | ‘triphalasalilayoge bhṛṅgarājadraveṇa haviṣi ca viṣamiśre kṣīra ājye madhūke | pratipadamabhitaptaṃ saptadhā sīsamekaṃ praṇihitagatipaścāt kārayettacchalākam || timirapaṭalakaṇḍvāsrāvaraktaprakopāmupacitabahu-doṣānnarmasaṃjñāṃstu rogān | saviturudayakāle sāñjanā vyañjanā vā harati nayanarogān śodhyamānā śalākā’ iti | vāgbhaṭe'pi - ‘śreṣṭhājalaṃ bhṛṅgarasaṃ saviṣājyamajāpayaḥ | yaṣṭīrasaṃ ca yat sīsaṃ saptakṛtva: pṛthak pṛthak || taptaṃ taptaṃ pāyitaṃ tacchalākā netre yuktā sāñjanā vyañjanā vā | taimiryārmasrāvapaicchilyapaillaṃ kaṇḍūṃ jāḍyaṃ raktarājīṃ ca hanti’ iti ( vā. u. 13|34|35) || 115 || 116 ||
Gū. atha sīsakaśalākā | triphalā bhṛṅgaṃ bhṛṅgarājaḥ śuṇṭhī eṣāṃ rasaiḥ jalaiḥ sarpiṣā ghṛtena gomūtramadhu ajā kṣīraiḥ etaiḥ saptasaptavāraṃ siktaḥ secito nāgaḥ | sīsakaśalākā netrarujaḥ haret | triphalādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ rasaiḥ sapta saptadhā sikta ityarthaḥ | tathāca suśrute - ‘triphalābhṛṅgamahauṣadhasarpirgomūtramadhvajākṣīraiḥ | nāgaṃ saptaniṣiktaṃ karoti garuḍopamaṃ cakṣuḥ’ iti | triphalādīnāṃ samāhāraḥ dvandvātpratyekaṃ rase niṣecanamiti dhvanitam | iti sīsakaśalākā || 115 || 116 ||
pratyañjanam | gatadoṣamapetāśru saṃpaśyansamyagambhasi | prakṣālyākṣi yathādoṣaṃ kāryaṃ pratyañjanaṃ tataḥ ||117|| na vā'nirgatadoṣe'kṣṇi dhāvanaṃ saṃprayojayet | pratyañjanaṃ tīkṣṇatapte netre cūrṇaṃ prasādanam || 118 || nayanāmṛtāñjanam | śuddhe nāge drute śuddhaṃ tulyaṃ sūtaṃ vinikṣipet | kṛṣṇāñjanaṃ tayostulyaṃ sarvamekatra cūrṇayet || 119 || daśamāṃśena karpūraṃ tasmiṃścūrṇe pradāpayet | etatkṛtāñjanaṃ netragadajinnayanāmṛtam || 120 ||
Dī. idānīṃ cūrṇāñjanāntargataṃ pratyañjanavidhānamāha - akṣi prakṣālya tataḥ pratyañjanaṃ kāryam | netre tīkṣṇapratapte prasādanaṃ cūrṇaṃ hitam | śeṣaṃ sugamam ||117 || 118 || atha prasādanaṃ cūrṇāñjanamāha - nāgaṃ sīsakaṃ nāgaśuddhistu pūrvaṃ dhātuśodhanā'dhyāye kathitā | sūtaṃ pāradaṃ śuddhamiti śodhitaṃ | śuddhirasasya pūrvaṃ rasaśodhanādhyāye pratipāditā | kṛṣṇāñjanamiti rasāñjanaśabdavācyaṃ tacca dvividham ekaṃ kṛṣṇapāṣāṇākṛtidhātudravyam | aparaṃ tu dāruharidrākkāthena kṛtrimaṃ pītalohitaṃ tayostulyamiti pāradasīsakasāmyaṃ rasāñjanamityaryaḥ | trayāṇāṃ daśāṃśenātra karpūramiti | idaṃ nayanāmṛtaṃ nāma prasādāñjanacūrṇaṃ prasiddhameva kṛtāñjanasthāne pratyañjanamiti pāṭhāntaram || 119 || 120||
Gū. pratyañjanakaraṇe vidhānamāha - sīsakaśalākayā vahnitaptayā añjane kṛte doṣanāśe pratyañjanaṃ kartavyamityāha - gatadoṣaṃ tathā nayanāstraṃ gatanetrajalam akṣi netram ambhasi saṃpaśyan | tataḥ akṣi prakṣālya yathā doṣānurūpaṃ pratyañjanamañjanaṃ sadoṣe netre dhāvanaṃ netramityapyāha -anirvāntadoṣe'kṣṇi dhāvanaṃ na prayojayet | na kārayet | pratyañjanaṃ kārayet| prakṣālanaṃ vinaiveti dhvanitārtha: | tīkṣṇaṃ tannetre prasādanaścūrṇo vā kārya: | sa yathā - śuddhe tailādibhi: śuddhe vā śalākākāreṇa śuddhe nāge sīsake sati drutaṃ vahninā drāvitaṃ nāgaṃ śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ hiṅgulotthaṃ aṣṭakarmaśuddhaṃ vā tulyaṃ nikṣipet | tayo: sīsakasūtakayostulyaṃ kṛṣṇāñjanaṃ cūrṇayet | tata: sarvamekatra cūrṇayet | tasmina cūrṇe karpūraṃ bhīmasenākhyaṃ daśamāṃśena pradāpayet | etatpratyañjanaṃnāma netragadahā nayanāmṛtaṃ pratyañjanaṃ cūrṇam ||117|| ||120||
sarpaviṣe saṃjīvanāñjanam | jayapālabhavāṃ majjāṃ bhāvayennimbukadravai: | ekaviṃśativelaṃ tu tato vartiṃ prakalpayet ||121|| manuṣyalālayā ghṛṣṭvā tato netre tayā'ñjayet | sarpadaṣṭaviṣaṃ jitvā saṃjīvayati mānavam ||122||
Dī. atha netraprakaraṇapāriśeṣyāt viṣaharī vartimāha - jayapālaṃ dantibījaṃ prasiddham | tanmadhyagatā majjā grāhyā | majjeti meṅgīśabdavācyā sarpadaṣṭaviṣamapi viṣasādharmyāt sthāvaraviṣatakṣaṇepyasyā: pracāra: | eke sannipātaviṣaye'ñjanamasyā: pravadanti || 121|| 122 | |
Gū. atha sarpaviṣaharamañjanam | sugamam ||121|| || 122||
atha dṛṣṭiprasādanārthaṃ sārvakālikaṃ yogadvayamāha - bhuktvā pāṇitalaṃ ghṛṣṭvā cakṣuṣordīyate yadi | jātā rogā vinaśyanti timirāṇi tathaiva ca ||123|| śītāmbupūritamukha: prativāsaraṃ ya: kālatrayeṇa nayanadvitayaṃ jalena | āsiñcati dhruvamasau na kadācidakṣi- rogavyathāvidhuratāṃ bhajate manuṣya: || 124||
Dī. bhuktvā pāṇitalamityādi sugamam | jātārogā ityādi padadvayaṃ kecidanyathā paṭhanti | yathā ‘acireṇaiva tadvāri timirāṇi vyapohatīti’ dvitīyayoge prativāsaraṃ pratidinaṃ kālatrayaṃ prātarmadhyāhṇāparahṇādikam | jaleneti mukhagaṇḍūṣajanitena āsiñcatītyanena vāraṃvāraṃ secanamabhihitam | tathācoktaṃ ‘jalagaṇḍūṣai: prātarbahuśombhobhiḥ prapūrya mukharandhram | nirdayamañjannakṣi kṣapayati timirāṇi nāsādya’ iti | eke bhuktvā pāṇitalamityādi yogadvayaṃ nātra paṭhanti | nāsaṅgatamiti manyamānairasmābhirapi likhitam || 123-124 ||
atha trikhaṇḍānāṃ pāriśeṣyāt kavirapi khaguṇaprakarṣatāṃ solluṇṭhavacanena dyotayati -- āyurvedasamudrasya gūḍhārthamaṇisaṃcayam | jñātvā kaiścidbudhaistaistu kṛtā vividhasaṃhitāḥ ||125|| kiṃcidarthaṃ tato nītvā kṛteyaṃ saṃhitā mayā | kṛpākaṭākṣanikṣepamasyāṃ kurvantu sādhavaḥ || 126 || vividhagadārtidaridranāśanaṃ yā hariramaṇīva karoti yogaratnaiḥ | vilasatu śārṅgadharasya saṃhitā sā kavihṛdayeṣu sarojanirmaleṣu || 127 || alpāyuṣāmalpadhiyāmidānīṃ kṛtaṃ samastaśrutipāṭhaśaktyā | tadatra yuktaṃ pratibījamātra- mabhyasyatāmātmahitaṃ prayatnāt || 128 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe netrakarmavidhi- rnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
Dī. atha netraviṣaya-pradhānatvena tadarthaṃ sarvakālaṃ yanna vidheyamiti matvā tat pratipālanārthamupadeśamāha – ‘cakṣūrakṣāyāṃ sarvakālaṃ manuṣyai- ryatna: kartavyo jīvite yāvadicchā | vyartho loko'yaṃ tulyarātrindivānāṃ puṃsāmandhānāṃ vidyamāne'pi vitte ||’ ayamapi tantrāntarādāhṛtya kenāpi likhitaḥ na svamatam | asyārthastu sugama eva || dī. - āyurvedasamudrasya arthamaṇisañcayaḥ | gūḍha eva gūḍho guptaḥ, yathā samudre maṇisamūhaḥ pracchannaḥ sarvaireva na dṛśyaḥ tathā'yurvede'pi artho'bhiprāyaḥ | sarvaireva nādhigata ityarthaḥ | ata eva kaiścidbudhairjñātaḥ | arthamaṇisaṃcaya iti saṃbandhaḥ | yaireva jñātastaistu vividhā saṃhitāḥ kṛtāḥ | vividhasaṃhitā hārītasuśrutabhṛgvagniveśādayaḥ | atha kaviḥ svātmīyaviṣayamāha –kiṃcidarthamityādi | tata iti saṃhitāsamūhāt | mayā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa kiṃcidarthaṃ svabuddhyā ekadeśīyaprayojanaṃ nītvā āhṛtya iyaṃ saṃhitā kṛtā nibaddhetyabhiprāyaḥ | na tu khakapolakalpitā | etena munipraṇītatvaṃ saṃkṣepatvaṃ ca darśitam | atha kavivijñaptimāha - kṛpākaṭākṣanikṣepamityādi | asyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ sādhavaḥ sajjanāḥ kṛpākaṭākṣanikṣepaṃ kṛpayā kaṭākṣasya dṛṣṭeḥ kiṃcidbhāgasya nikṣepaṃ kurvantu | anumatārthakriyā avaśyameveti bhāvaṃ sūcayati | tenāvaśyameva kaṭākṣanikṣepaṃ kurvaṃtu | yataḥ kaṭākṣamātrā'valokanenā'pi hṛdayaṃgamā kṣamā bhavati kimuta sakaladṛṣṭyā | etena granthasya samīcīnatā darśitā | idānīṃ kavireva nijagranthasyotkṛṣṭatvamāha - yā iyaṃ saṃhitā hariramaṇīva lakṣmīriva yogaratnaiḥ prayogamaṇisamūhaiḥ kṛtvā vividhagadārtidaridranāśanaṃ karoti | vividhagadānāṃ vyādhīnām ārtireva dāridryaṃ tasya nāśanaṃ yathā lakṣmīrbahudhanapradānena akiṃcanapuruṣasya daridranāśaṃ karoti tathā iyamapi saṃhitā suyogaiḥ kṛtvā nānārogajanitapīḍāṃ hantīti bhāvaḥ | etenāsyāḥ prayogasāphalyaṃ darśitam | tat prayogasāphalyasya vyāpāramāha - vilasatvityādi | sā saṃhitā, saṃhitā niruktistu pūrvādhyāye darśitā | śārṅgadharācāryasya sā saṃhitā śārṅgadharācāryanirmitā sā ityabhiprāyaḥ | nānyā | etena granthasya sarvamatānubandhatvaṃ darśitaṃ, sarojanirmaleṣu kavihṛdayeṣviti vilasatu vilāsaṃ karotu kamalanirmalahṛdayapuruṣeṣu sthitiṃ karotvityabhiprāyaḥ | na tu piśunahṛdayeṣu teṣāṃ hṛdayānāmanirmalatvāt na tasyāḥ sthiteravakāśaḥ | yataste svabhāvavaśagāḥ kathaṃ paraguṇamavadhārayituṃ samarthāḥ | tasmāt sajjanahṛdayeṣveva vilāsa iti bhāvaḥ | sahṛdayatvāt | etena granthasya nirmalatvaṃ sūcitaṃ yato nirmalasya nirmalaiḥ saha saṃbandhaḥ sukara eva || 125-128 || vividhamuninibandhā ye mahatsuprasiddhāḥ, sumatiduravabodhāste mayā naiva dṛṣṭāḥ | tadapi gurusakāśādyacchrutaṃ tadvyalekhi hyaḍhamalabhiṣajā'syāṃ bhāvasiṃhātmajena || 1 || abhinavanibandharacanāṃ śrotuṃ kaḥ ko'tra lolupo bhavati | yaḥ kṛpayā parakāvyaṃ paśyati sudṛśā sa vai dhīraḥ ||2|| ekādaśasahasrāṇi tathā.... ...... ... | śakānāmāḍhamallo hi pañjikāyāṃ vinirmame ||3|| govardhanoddharaṇahṛṣṭasamastagopa- nānāśrutiśravaṇalajjitamānasasya (?) | indukalāsamānaṃ daṃṣṭrodyuti kṣitihareravatu smitaṃ vaḥ || 4 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātma- jenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharapyaṃhitāyāṃ dīpikāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe netrakarmādividhi- radhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ ||
Gū. atha samāptau granthakāraḥ svakīyaṃ vinayaṃ karoti | sugamam | vinayaṃ kṛtvā autkṛṣṭyamāha - śārṅgadharasya saṃhitā kavihṛdayeṣu vilasatu viśeṣeṇa lasatu prakāśatu | kathaṃbhūteṣu hṛdayeṣu | sarojanirmaleṣu kamalavat śuddheṣu | sā kā ? yā hariramaṇīva lakṣmīriva yogaratnairvividhagadārtidaridranāśaṃ karoti | yujyanta iti yogāḥ kvāthacūrṇādīnāṃ gaṇā rasādayaśca, taiḥ nānāvidhajvarādirogāṇāṃ ārtiḥ pīḍā tasyā yo daridrastannāśaṃ karoti || 125-128 || śrīmat śāhasalemasya rājye kanyāgate ravau | ... .... ..... .. ... .. .... ... .... .. ... .. ... || 1 || kāśīrāmabhiṣagvaro madhukaraḥ śrīkṛṣṇapādābjayoḥ prācāṃ granthakṛtāṃ nibandhakusumādāhṛtya mādhvīmiva | vaidyānāmupakārakṛttanubhṛtāṃ rogaprahāre kṣamāṃ saśrīśārṅgadharaprabandhaviśadavyākhyāmakārṣītsvayam|| 2 || iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne netrakarmaprasādananāmādhyāyaḥ | iti trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ | śārṅgadharasaṃhitā samāptā |
